# Codebase map

Deep reference for `mindbound/Hbm-s-Nuclear-Tech-DBS` (NTM: Space fork). Paths are repo-relative; `com/hbm/...` means `src/main/java/com/hbm/...`. Line numbers are from the 2026-09-24 snapshot as re-checked on 2026-09-25 (`src/` was unchanged since `22c9c89c` until 2026-09-26, when the fork version identity added `com/hbm/dbs/DBSVersion.java`, rewrote `HTTPHandler.loadStats`/`loadVersion` and replaced three MOTD lines in `ModEventHandler` one for one (fully qualified `com.hbm.dbs.DBSVersion`, no new import, so its line numbers are unchanged); the `DBSFork` javadoc was also reworded; `MainRegistry` anchors are current and count the fork hook at L285) and will drift; method and class names are the stable anchors. Every area was surveyed and then adversarially verified against source; where the verifier could not settle a point it is listed under "Open questions". On 2026-09-25 every area was verified again from the owner's local clone, with vanilla/Forge/NEI/OC behaviour settled by `javap` on the dependency jars; 270 corrections that survived an independent re-check were applied (wrong or stale claims, imprecise wording, missing gotchas), and answered open questions became facts. On 2026-09-26 the owner's mod pack (solo play; a DIY collection with many GTNH forks, among them OpenComputers 1.12.62, NotEnoughItems 2.8.146, AE2 rv3-beta-1071, Angelica and hodgepodge, plus EndlessIDs, but no GregTech) was inspected through its jars' bytecode, its configs and its logs; where it changes how this code behaves, the area says so under "Owner's pack". Versions and settings are in `docs/fork-notes.md` ("Owner's play environment"), third-party patches on HBM members in `docs/extending.md` (section 7). How to add content from fork code without touching upstream registries, and the persisted-ID registries with the fork ID bands (adopted 2026-09-26), are in `docs/extending.md`.

Areas:

1. Bootstrap, lifecycle, config, commands
2. Public API packages (`api.hbm`, `cofh`) and repo meta
3. Blocks: registration and generic blocks
4. Blocks: machines, bombs, networks (BlockDummyable)
5. Tile entities: base classes and common machines
6. Tile entities: RBMK, fusion, Albion, bombs, turrets, deco
7. Energy/fluid networks (UNINOS) and packet threading
8. Items
9. Weapons: sedna gun system, projectiles, missiles, grenades
10. Recipes, ore dictionary, fluids, materials, item pools
11. Containers, GUIs, NEI
12. Entities, mobs, explosions
13. Hazards, radiation, pollution, neutron, atmosphere, compat, saved data
14. Dimensions and world generation (NTM: Space)
15. Client rendering, models, animations, particles, sound
16. Networking, packets, utilities, wiaj
17. Resources, localization, build, tooling
18. OpenComputers integration

## 1. Bootstrap, lifecycle, config, commands

### Purpose

`com/hbm/main/MainRegistry.java` is the single `@Mod` class (modid `hbm`). It owns every FML lifecycle hook, all registration ordering, config loading, command registration and missing-mapping remaps. `ServerProxy`/`ClientProxy` are the sided proxies. Four `ModEventHandler*` classes subscribe to the Forge/FML buses. `com/hbm/config/` holds the Forge-`Configuration`-backed static config classes (one `hbm.cfg`) plus JSON runtime configs written to `config/hbmConfig/`. `com/hbm/commands/` holds the `/ntm*` commands. `extprop/` carries per-entity radiation/keybind/shield state, `potion/` the reflective potion registrar, `qmaw/` the F1 manual, `module/` reusable TE helper objects, `interfaces/` marker interfaces and annotations.

### Patterns

- Sided proxy: `@SidedProxy(clientSide=RefStrings.CLIENTSIDE, serverSide=RefStrings.SERVERSIDE) public static ServerProxy proxy`. Add a new client hook to `ServerProxy` first, as a no-op or a server-correct default, override it in `ClientProxy`, and call `MainRegistry.proxy.x()` from common code. The proxy is chosen per JVM, so in single-player the integrated-server thread also gets the `ClientProxy` override: an override must tolerate server-side callers, or the caller must check `world.isRemote`. Not every `ServerProxy` method is a no-op: `registerMissileItems`, `getSubItems` and `getImpactDust/Fire/Impact` have real server implementations that `ClientProxy` replaces without calling super. Live case: `OreDictStack.extractForNEI` (`RecipesCommon.java:468`), which common recipe code also calls, expands a wildcard stack through `proxy.getSubItems` into every subitem in single-player but returns the single stack on a dedicated server.
- PreLoad order: `CrashHelper.init` -> config dirs -> `Identity.init` (writes `identity` into top-level `config/`, not `hbmConfig`) -> `loadConfig()` -> `HbmPotion.init` -> `Mats.MAT_STONE` touch -> `Fluids.init` -> `proxy.registerPreRenderInfo` -> `ModBlocks.mainRegistry` -> `ModItems.mainRegistry` -> `com.hbm.dbs.DBSFork.init` (fork hook: creative tabs + recipe listener) -> `ModBiomes.init` -> `proxy.registerRenderInfo` -> `HbmWorld.mainRegistry` -> FuelHandler -> `BulletConfigSyncingUtil` -> `CellularDungeonFactory` -> `XSatelliteRegistry` -> `HTTPHandler.loadStats` -> `CraftingManager.mainRegistry` -> `SiegeTier` -> `HazardRegistry.registerItems/registerTrafos` -> `XWeaponModManager` -> `SolarSystem.init` -> `OreDictManager` (`EVENT_BUS.register(new OreDictManager())`, `registerGroups` BEFORE `registerOres`) -> `BiomeGenCraterBase.initDictionary` (if crater biomes) -> repair items -> `NetworkRegistry.registerGuiHandler(GUIHandler)` -> `TileMappings.writeMappings` -> `MachineDynConfig.initialize` -> `TileEntityLaunchPadBase.registerLaunchables` -> `GameRegistry.registerTileEntity(WithAlternatives)` loop (L339-345) -> ChestGenHooks -> `EntityMappings.writeMappings` -> ForgeChunkManager callback -> `DispenserBehaviorHandler` -> `MicroBlocksCompatHandler.preInit`.
- Second preinit (`preInit`): registers `ModEventHandler` (FML + EVENT_BUS + TERRAIN_GEN_BUS + ORE_GEN_BUS), `ModEventHandlerImpact`, `PacketDispatcher.registerPackets()`, `ChunkRadiationManager`, `PollutionHandler`, `DamageResistanceHandler`, `ChunkAtmosphereManager`, `CelestialNukeShockHandler`, `NeutronHandler`, `BlockMigrations`; client: `HbmKeybinds.register()`.
- `load`: `RodRecipes.registerInit`, achievements + `AchievementPage` (L468), `BobmazonOfferFactory.init` (after achievements), `IMCHandler.registerHandler("blastfurnace"/"crystallizer"/"centrifuge")`, `PlanetGen.init`, GTNH-NEI gate (L544-548).
- `PostLoad` order (load-bearing): `Fluids.reloadFluids` + `FluidContainerRegistry.register` -> MagicRecipes/Lemegeton/SILEX/GasCentrifuge -> `CustomMachineConfigJSON.initialize` -> `SerializableRecipe.registerAllHandlers` + `initialize` -> `AnvilRecipes.register` -> `RadiolysisRecipes` (throws if `CrackingRecipes` empty) -> `FalloutConfigJSON` -> `ItemPoolConfigJSON` -> `ClientConfig.initConfig` (also on dedicated server) + `ServerConfig.initConfig` -> `TileEntityNukeCustom.registerBombItems` -> `ArmorUtil.register` (L600, hazard classes) -> `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmats` (L601, rad resistance; the `ArmorFSB` queues `ArmorUtil.external`/`HazmatRegistry.external` are drained only here, so armor must be constructed before PostLoad; earlier direct writes to the same key are overwritten here, the tables stay writable afterwards and later `registerHazard`/`registerHazmat` calls win, and a live `hbmRadResist.json` replaces the rad-resistance table wholesale) -> DamageResistance/BlockToolConversion/AchievementHandler -> `MobUtil` pools -> `LogicBlock*` -> `proxy.registerMissileItems` -> `CompatHandler.init` (OC, L615) -> `AE2CompatHandler.init` (L618) -> `World.MAX_ENTITY_RADIUS = max(.., 8.75)` (L621; the global entity-collision search radius, sized for the Quackos; raise it here for entities wider than 17.5 m) -> `SchistStratum` on EVENT_BUS (L623) -> `OreLayer3D`/`OreCave` instances -> `BedrockOre.init` -> `PlanetGen.overrideOverworldProvider` -> `Compat.handleRailcraftNonsense` (unregisters Railcraft's TrailTicker) -> client commands (`SuicideThreadDump`, `CommandReloadClient`, `CommandWikiRender`) -> `WorldTypeTeleport.init`.
- `serverStart(FMLServerStartingEvent)`: `RBMKDials.createDials(world)`, then `event.registerServerCommand(new CommandX())` for each command, then `ArcFurnaceRecipes.registerFurnaceSmeltables()` (deferred so other mods' furnace recipes exist).
- Forge config: one `Configuration(event.getSuggestedConfigurationFile())`; each `XConfig` has `public static` fields + `static void loadFromConfig(Configuration)`; keys `N.NN_camelName` under `CommonConfig.CATEGORY_*`; `config.save()` once. Values are final after preinit (no reload). MobConfig uses `12.M00_`, RadiationConfig `FOG_00_`/`AMBIENT_00_`/`RADIATION_99_`.
- JSON runtime config: subclass `RunningConfig`, `public static ConfigWrapper<T> NAME = new ConfigWrapper(default)`, register in `initDefaults()` into `configMap`; read with `ServerConfig.X.get()`; `/ntmserver help|list|reload|get|set`. Caution: `CommandReloadConfig.canCommandSenderUseCommand` returns `sender instanceof EntityPlayer`, which replaces CommandBase's op-level check. Any player, op or not, can change or reload server variables, and the console, RCON and command blocks cannot use the command.
- Template-vs-live JSON pattern (Fallout, ItemPools, `hbmArmor.json`, `hbmRadResist.json`, `hbmFluidTraits.json`, `hbmRecipes/`): defaults are built in code, and `_hbmX.json` is written only while `hbmX.json` is absent. When the live file is present it REPLACES the defaults. Defaults added in later versions therefore never reach anyone with a live file, and their `_` template goes stale (tell testers to delete the live file). A Fallout read error, or a RadResist whole-file parse error, silently discards the live file and keeps the defaults (stack trace only).
- Missing mappings: `handleMissingMappings` fills `ignoreMappings` (HashSet) and `remapItems` (5 entries), ignores `hbm:item.ammo_*` prefix, remaps ITEM types only; there is no block remap branch.
- Keybinds: static `KeyBinding` in `HbmKeybinds`; server side via `EnumKeybind` -> `KeybindPacket` -> `HbmPlayerProps.setKeyPressed`; items implement `IKeybindReceiver`. QMAW/Jars use raw `Keyboard.isKeyDown(HbmKeybinds.qmaw.getKeyCode())` in `ModEventHandlerClient.clientTick`, not `getIsKeyPressed`.
- Marker annotations: `@Spaghetti(String)` (~26 uses), `@Untested` (~14), `@NotableComments` (~39); purely documentary.
- Logging: `MainRegistry.logger` (`LogManager.getLogger("HBM")`, static initializer at L121; the `event.getModLog()` fallback in `preInit` (L683-684) is dead because the field is never null, so all output goes to the Log4j logger "HBM", never to FML's mod log) is used in ~92 files and is the only logger (`CompatHandler` fetches the same `"HBM"` logger). Prefix the subsystem in brackets (`[QMAW]` 13 uses, `[Debug]` 10, `[Jigsaw]`, `[DET]`, `[BOMBPL]`). 62 `System.out.println` calls in 24 files are legacy; do not add more. Where it lands (owner's MultiMC instance): `MainRegistry.logger` lines (`[HBM/hbm]`) appear in `logs/fml-client-latest.log` and the rotated `fml-client-1..3.log` (four sessions of history), never in `logs/latest.log` or its `*.log.gz` archives; vanilla warnings about `hbm:` resources (SoundHandler `File hbm:sounds/... does not exist`, TextureManager `Failed to load texture: hbm:...`) appear only in `latest.log` and the archives. A few HBM lines logged on NEI worker threads also reach the cumulative `logs/fml-junk-earlystartup.log`.
- Debug aids: `GeneralConfig.enableDebugMode` (`hbm.cfg` `1.00_enableDebugMode`; 24 sites: worldgen/dungeon/NBT-structure spawn logging, meteor-shower logging, per-player atmosphere logging every 20 ticks in `ChunkAtmosphereHandler.canBreathe`, `ItemStructureTool` writing `hbmConfig/structureOutput.txt`, and the `!gv` chat command for HbMinecraft's UUID only), `ServerConfig.STRUCTURE_DEBUG` (below), `ClientConfig.SHOW_BLOCK_META_OVERLAY` and `DODD_RBMK_DIAGNOSTIC` (`/ntmclient set ...`; look overlays), `MobConfig.waypointDebug` (renders glyphid waypoints), `/ntmpackets info`, `/ntmrad`, `/ntmlocate`, `/ntmloadchunk`; F3+T fires `HFRModelReloader` (OBJ/VBO rebuild) and `QMAWLoader`; the dev run dir is `eclipse/` (`.gitignore`d, holds its own `config/`).
- `ServerConfig.STRUCTURE_DEBUG` (`/ntmserver set STRUCTURE_DEBUG true`): at runtime it stops logic/loot wand blocks replacing themselves when a structure is built (`BlockWandLogic`/`BlockWandLoot.transformTE`) and unlocks `SpawnCondition.buildAll(world, x, y, z)` (nothing calls it; call it from a debug hook). Its palette effects (air -> `wand_air`, jigsaw blocks kept; `NBTStructure` L367/L440) apply only while an `.nbt` is parsed. The bundled structures are `StructureManager` statics, parsed in PreLoad (`HbmWorld.mainRegistry` -> `new NTMWorldGenerator()`), before `hbmServer.json` is read in PostLoad, so the flag never affects them. `BlockWandStructure` sets the flag to `!powered` around its own file load and restores it afterwards (L231-251). `[Jigsaw]` warnings are always logged.

### How-to

- New `hbm.cfg` option: pick or add a `CommonConfig.CATEGORY_*`; add `public static <type> field = default;` to the matching `XConfig`; in `loadFromConfig` add `field = CommonConfig.createConfigBool(config, CATEGORY, "N.NN_fieldName", "comment", default);`, keeping the numeric sequence. The min/max `createConfigInt` overload does NOT clamp (Forge stores the bounds as metadata only), so validate by hand; `setDef` only guards values <= 0. For a new class, add `XConfig.loadFromConfig(config)` in `MainRegistry.loadConfig()` before `config.save()`. `hbm.cfg` is never synced: options that affect logic running on both sides must be set identically on client and server. Exemplar `com/hbm/config/ToolConfig.java`.
- Runtime-editable option: in `ServerConfig`/`ClientConfig` add `public static ConfigWrapper<Boolean> MY_FLAG = new ConfigWrapper(false);` and `configMap.put("MY_FLAG", MY_FLAG);` in `initDefaults()`. Only String/Float/Double/Integer/Boolean are supported; other types (Long, enums, lists) are silently never read, written or settable. Values load in PostLoad, so do not read them from static initializers or during PreLoad/init. ServerConfig is never synced to clients: read it only on server-side code paths (client-side reads see the client's own `hbmServer.json`).
- New `/ntm*` command: `CommandBase` subclass in `com/hbm/commands/`; register it in `serverStart(FMLServerStartingEvent)`. The default permission is level 4 (ops only); lower it by overriding `getRequiredPermissionLevel()` (e.g. 2, like `CommandTotalTime`). Override `canCommandSenderUseCommand` only if you mean to replace the op check entirely, as `CommandReloadConfig`, `CommandCustomize` and `CommandWikiRender` do. Client-only commands self-register in a static `register()` guarded by `FMLLaunchHandler.side() != Side.CLIENT` and called from PostLoad. Exemplar `CommandRadiation.java`.
- Machine config via `hbmMachines.json`: implement `com.hbm.tileentity.IConfigurableMachine` (`getConfigName`, `readIfPresent`, `writeConfig`). `readIfPresent` must assign `public static` fields: `MachineDynConfig` calls it on a throwaway `newInstance()` dummy, so instance fields are lost. Read values with `IConfigurableMachine.grab(obj, "I:key", default)`; the overload is chosen by the default's type (boolean/int/long/double only). The `I:/L:/D:/B:` prefixes are a naming convention only; `D[:` arrays are hand-parsed (Diesel) and `M:` nested modules call the module's own `readIfPresent` (the existing `M:burnModule` reads never apply, see Known bugs). The TE needs a public no-arg constructor with no side effects and must be registered in `TileMappings.writeMappings()` (put() auto-adds it to `configurables`). The file is read once in PreLoad (no reload), and exceptions are swallowed per machine. Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.java`.
- Client keybind: `KeyBinding` field + `ClientRegistry.registerKeyBinding` in `HbmKeybinds.register()`, lang `hbm.key.foo`; for server awareness add an `EnumKeybind` constant, a case in `ClientProxy.getIsKeyPressed`, and handle in `HbmPlayerProps.setKeyPressed` or `IKeybindReceiver`.
- Extended-props field: add it to `HbmPlayerProps`/`HbmLivingProps` and persist it in `saveNBTData`/`loadNBTData`. Append it to `serialize`/`deserialize` in the same order if the client needs it. That data goes out in `ExtPropPacket` to the owning player every tick, so keep it small. On death only the `HbmPlayerProps.serialize` subset survives (`onPlayerClone` copies it and never checks `wasDeath`), and `HbmLivingProps` (radiation, contamination, digamma...) resets. On End-portal return Forge's `clonePlayer(old, true)` hands the new player the old `extendedProperties` map, so both classes survive intact (the stale `HbmPlayerProps.player` reference there is B-331).
- New potion: `PotionConfig` id (`8.NN_fooID`, at most 127, see Gotchas), `HbmPotion.registerPotion(...)` in `init()`, branches in `performEffect`/`isReady`, icon in `textures/gui/potions.png`, lang `potion.hbm_foo`.
- Creative tab: subclass in `com/hbm/creativetabs/` with null-guarded `getTabIconItem()`; static in `MainRegistry` with `CreativeTabs.getNextID()`; lang `itemGroup.tabFoo`.
- QMAW page: see area 17 (all four of `name`, `title`, `content`, `trigger` are mandatory).
- Access transformer line: append `public net.minecraft.pkg.Class field_xxxxx_y # readableName` (or `func_...(desc)`), then `./gradlew clean setupDecompWorkspace`.
- IMC handler: `extends IMCHandler` (abstract class, `process(IMCMessage)`), `IMCHandler.registerHandler("key", new IMCFoo())` in `load()`; the whole inbound IMC API is @Deprecated.

### Gotchas

- Two `FMLPreInitializationEvent` handlers (`PreLoad`, `preInit`): `FMLModContainer.gatherAnnotations` collects `@EventHandler` methods in `Class.getDeclaredMethods()` order into an `ArrayListMultimap`, and `handleModStateEvent` calls them in that order. The JVM leaves that order unspecified, so treat it as undefined even if one run shows an order, and keep the two handlers independent (nothing currently cross-depends). `load`/`initIMC`/`PostLoad` are static; `PreLoad`/`preInit`/`serverStart`/`handleMissingMappings` are instance methods.
- ForgeChunkManager `LoadingCallback` (`PreLoad` ~L364-379) `return`s after the first NORMAL ticket, so ENTITY tickets listed after it in the same world are never re-`init()`ed on load.
- `TileMappings.put` is private (`TileMappings.java:568`); registration happens only inside `writeMappings()`.
- `HbmPotion.registerPotion` resizes to `new Potion[Math.max(256, id)]`, so ids >= 256 throw AIOOBE, and a reflection failure is swallowed silently (Java 8 only). Vanilla also sends and saves the potion id as a signed byte (`S1DPacketEntityEffect`, PotionEffect NBT `Id`), so ids 128-255 reach the client as negative ids and are dropped on save/load. Keep PotionConfig ids at or below 127, above vanilla's range (the defaults 62-77 are fine). Both failure modes apply only with vanilla-sized `Potion.potionTypes` and vanilla byte ids (B-002): the AIOOBE is HBM's own off-by-one (the new array is `id` long, `HbmPotion.java:86`) and fires only while `Potion.potionTypes` is not longer than the id; the byte-id loss is vanilla's. Owner's pack: EndlessIDs widens `Potion.potionTypes` to 65536 (so the resize branch never runs) and carries ids above 127 as an int, while hodgepodge masks every `PotionEffect` id with `& 255`, so ids 128-255 work there, and ids of 256 and up are masked to `id & 255`: the effect silently becomes another potion or an empty slot (NPE in `PotionEffect.onUpdate`). Keep the 127 cap for portability.
- `onPlayerClone` never checks `event.wasDeath`. On death the NBT-only fields (`hasWarped`, `lastDimension`, `maskManTimer`, `nitanCount`) and the transient ones (dash/stamina, `keysPressed`) reset; because the reset `hasWarped=false` is then saved, a player on a `WorldTypeTeleport` (martian) world is warped to Duna again at their next login (B-005, D2). End-portal return keeps every prop (Forge's `clonePlayer(old, true)` hands over the old map) but leaves `HbmPlayerProps.player` pointing at the old entity (B-331).
- `ExtPropPacket` streams `HbmLivingProps.serialize` then `HbmPlayerProps.serialize`; any order change desyncs everything after it.
- `hbm.cfg` values never reload; only `ServerConfig`/`ClientConfig` JSON do. `/ntmreload` re-runs fluids, serializable recipes, item pools, armor resistances, logic blocks. It does not re-run `RadiolysisRecipes` (derived from cracking recipes in PostLoad), `FalloutConfigJSON`, `CustomMachineConfigJSON`, `MachineDynConfig` or `HazmatRegistry` (`hbmRadResist.json`), and it does not re-send recipe files to connected clients when `0.05_enableServerRecipeSync` is on (that sync runs only at login, `ModEventHandler.java:247-266`).
- RBMK tuning is not in `hbm.cfg` but in gamerules (`RBMKDials`, area 6). Gamerules are stored once per save (each `WorldServerMulti` has a `DerivedWorldInfo` that delegates to the overworld's GameRules), but `RBMKDials` caches values per `World` object, and `serverStart` fills only the overworld cache. The first dial lookup in any other dimension calls `setOrCreateGameRule(key, default)` (`RBMKDials.java:146`), resetting that dial to its default for the whole save. `/gamerule` refreshes only the sender's dimension cache, so other loaded dimensions keep stale values.
- `GeneralConfig.enable528` forces `enableLBSM=false`; `enableThermosPreventer` throws from `loadConfig` when Thermos is on the classpath; `enableRenderDistCheck` clamps render distance to 16 unless OptiFine/Angelica.
- Biome ID collisions: intra-NTM duplicates in `hbm.cfg` always crash (`SpaceConfig.createConfigBiome`); cross-mod collisions crash from `BiomeGenBaseCelestial`/`BiomeGenCraterBase` constructors only when `1.92_crashOnBiomeConflict` is true.
- `HbmKeybinds.slamKey`/`EnumKeybind.SLAM` has no `ClientProxy.getIsKeyPressed` case and no handler (dormant).
- Update check (fork version identity; B-008 fixed, D3 answered): `HTTPHandler.loadStats` starts the "NTM Version Checker" thread, which runs each download (version, Soyuz text, tips, space tips) in its own try/catch, so a failed version check no longer skips the tips. `loadVersion` reads `DBSVersion.REMOTE_SOURCE` (`com/hbm/dbs/DBSVersion.java` on the fork's `space-travel-twopointfive` branch) and compares its `REVISION` line with the local `DBSVersion.REVISION`, not `RefStrings.VERSION`, which stays upstream's value and is still rewritten by CI (`.github/workflows/build.yml:48`). The login MOTD shows `RefStrings.VERSION` plus `(DBS r<REVISION>)` (`ModEventHandler.java:205`), and a different remote revision (compared with `equals`, so also an older one on the branch, e.g. when a locally built jar has `REVISION` bumped before the push) prints "New DBS revision r<remote> is available!" with a link to the fork repository (`DBSVersion.PROJECT_URL`, L213). Keep `REVISION` declared on one line: `build.gradle` (the `_DBS<revision>` version suffix, L39) parses it with a regex, and the update check takes the first line containing `String REVISION` and the text between its first and last `"`; `tools/check-fork.sh` checks the wiring. Bump it when a build should supersede older DBS jars.
- `polaroidID` randomised 1..18 (never 4 or 9); NEIConfig hides `book_secret`/`book_of_`/`burnt_bark` unless it is 11 (easter egg).
- `ModEventHandler.worldTick` has a dead reflective `reference` field hack; `chatEvent` `!gv` only for HbMinecraft's UUID in debug mode.
- Loading screen: `ModEventHandlerClient.onClientTickLast` (LOWEST priority) reinstalls `LoadingScreenRendererNT` whenever `mc.loadingScreen` is something else, at most once every 5 s and at most 25 installs per session (counting the first), and only while `1.43_enableLoadScreenReplacement` is true. After that it gives up and leaves another mod's renderer in place.

### Known bugs and smells

- `FalloutConfigJSON.java:292`: `matchesMaterial` is read from key `"mustBeOpaque"`. An entry with `matchesMaterial` but no `mustBeOpaque` NPEs, and the entire user `hbmFallout.json` is discarded in favour of the defaults (stack trace only). The generated `_hbmFallout.json` contains such entries (the wood/leaves/plants/vine and sellafield material rules), so a renamed template never loads. If `mustBeOpaque` is also present, the material resolves to null, which drops the material filter (the entry matches any material).
- `commands/CommandReloadConfig.java:20-23`: the `sender instanceof EntityPlayer` override lets any player run `/ntmserver set|reload` and locks out the console (see Patterns, JSON runtime config).
- `tileentity/machine/TileEntityHeaterFirebox.java:93-94`, `TileEntityHeaterOven.java:122-123`, `TileEntityMachineRotaryFurnace.java:429-430`: `readIfPresent` tests `obj.has("burnModule")` but reads (and `writeConfig` writes) `M:burnModule`, so the nested burn-module config in `hbmMachines.json` is never applied.
- `handler/Identity.java:35`: writes `value + ""` (-1) instead of `newValue`; nothing reads `Identity.value`.
- `extprop/HbmLivingProps.java:496-498`: `ContaminationEffect.load` reads from parent `nbt` instead of child `me`; loaded effects come back with time/maxTime 0 (`getRad()` yields NaN, no exception).
- `BlockMigrations`: the lazy `buildNumber()` accessor (L14-20, parses `RefStrings.VERSION`) is never called; both `ChunkDataEvent` handlers read the raw field, so chunks are stamped -1 and the migration check never fires; `doMigraion` is an empty stub with a `for(y = height; y >= 0; y++)` loop (L43) that effectively never ends. Fixing the check (L31) without fixing the loop would hang chunk loading.
- `dim/SolarSystem.java:305`: `SolarSystem.init` (`MainRegistry` L300) calls `runTests()` unconditionally, which logs 31 INFO lines through `MainRegistry.logger` on every start: 18 delta-v and orbital-period test lines (including `Eve launch cost: 1.7976931348623157E308`, i.e. `Double.MAX_VALUE`) and 13 lines from `TileEntityDysonReceiver.runTests`. Log noise only (B-428); gating the call behind `GeneralConfig.enableDebugMode` or removing it silences it.
- TODOs: `MainRegistry.java:748` (CommandWikiRender clientside), `HbmPotion.java:234` (use an AT), `ModEventHandlerRenderer.java:673`, `HbmChestContents.java:19`. `MainRegistry.handleMissingMappings` is ~960 lines (925 hard-coded `ignoreMappings.add` strings, 5 item remaps, one dispatch loop).
- Duplicate key prefixes in `hbm.cfg` (cosmetic): 1.42, 1.43, 1.44 (General); 1.93, 16.24, 17.10 (Space); 2.18, 2.B08, 2.B09, 2.BN01, 2.C00, 2.C01, 2.L02, 5.03 (World); 8.11 (Potion); 12.D03 (Mob); HAZ_01 (Radiation).

### Open questions

- Whether `Identity.value` and `HbmKeybinds.slamKey` are unfinished features or dead.

## 2. Public API packages (`api.hbm`, `cofh`) and repo meta

### Purpose

`api.hbm` is the integration surface: interfaces that tiles, blocks, items and entities implement to join the HE power net (`energymk2`), the fluid net (`fluidmk2`; `fluid` is @Deprecated shims), conveyors, crucible metal flow, hand tools (`IToolable`), radar, Redstone-over-Radio (`redstoneoverradio`, "INDEX"), pneumatic item storage (`ntl`), station propulsion (`tile.IPropulsion`) and addon hooks (`recipe.IRecipeRegisterListener`, `fluidmk2.IFluidRegisterListener`). `PowerNetMK2`, `FluidNetMK2`, `Nodespace.PowerNode`, `FluidNode` are thin subclasses of the UNINOS engine (area 7). `cofh` is a vendored CoFH RedstoneFlux API used by the RF<->HE converters and by EMP/nuke drain code (`instanceof cofh.api.energy.IEnergyProvider`). Top-level source dirs are `api`, `cofh`, `com` only.

### Key files

| Path | Role |

| `api/hbm/energymk2/IEnergyProviderMK2.java` | Generator contract (24 implementing files): `usePower`, `getProviderSpeed`, `tryProvide(...)` registers with a cable net OR pushes directly into any adjacent receiver. |

### Patterns

- Hierarchy: receiver/provider -> `IEnergyHandlerMK2` -> (`IEnergyConnectorMK2`, `ILoadedTile`); conductors only `IEnergyConductorMK2`. Fluids mirror it with `IFluidUserMK2` and `IFluidPipeMK2`.
- Subscription by heartbeat: receivers call `trySubscribe` toward each connection point, providers `tryProvide`; both resolve the neighbour via `TileAccessCache`, check the conductor's `canConnect(dir.getOpposite())`, and stamp `System.currentTimeMillis()` into `NodeNet.receiverEntries`/`providerEntries`. Power looks up `Nodespace.getNode`, fluid `UniNodespace.getNode(world, x, y, z, type.getNetworkProvider())`. Entries older than 3000 ms or failing `isBadLink` are dropped. Convention: every tick or `worldObj.getTotalWorldTime() % 20 == 0`.
- Direct provision: `tryProvide` also pushes into ANY adjacent `IEnergyReceiverMK2` (conductor or not) when `canConnect` and `allowDirectProvision()` pass; the fluid side has no `allowDirectProvision` gate, only `canConnect(type, dir)`. A tile that is both conductor and receiver must override `allowDirectProvision()` to false (`TileEntityBatteryBase` does; `TileEntityProxyCombo` returns false unless built with `.power()`, then its core's value when the core is an `IEnergyReceiverMK2`, else true, `TileEntityProxyCombo.java:164-168`). The legacy `TileEntityMachineBattery` (in buffer mode) and `TileEntityMachineFENSU` (whose node always exists) do not, and their `canConnect` is true on every side (`TileEntityMachineBattery.java:315`), so a generator's `tryProvide` into them both joins their net and pushes power into them directly.
- Node lifecycle (cables/ducts): in `updateEntity` (server) `if(node == null || node.expired)` -> `getNode` else `createNode()` + `UniNodespace.createNode`; `invalidate()` -> `destroyNode`. `TileEntityCableBaseNT.shouldCreateNode()` gates creation. Machine-as-link: `TileEntityBatteryBase` (implements `IEnergyConductorMK2` + provider + receiver, manages membership directly with `node.net.addProvider/addReceiver/remove*` by mode, forces priority into LOW..HIGH) and the legacy, still-registered `TileEntityMachineBattery` (blocks `@Deprecated` in `ModBlocks`, creative tab null; own node only in buffer mode; in the other modes it adds or removes itself on neighbouring nodes' nets directly) and its subclass `TileEntityMachineFENSU` (always owns a node with a single NEG_Y connection). `TileEntityProxyCombo` is also an `IEnergyConductorMK2`, but it only forwards `canConnect` to its core (with `.power()`/`.conductor()`) and creates no node. Fluid tanks/barrels are ordinary transceivers, not links.
- Distribution: `PowerNetMK2.update` sums supply/demand per `ConnectionPriority`, iterates HIGHEST->LOWEST with weighted transfer, random "scapegoat" rounding loop; returns early unless BOTH provider and receiver maps are non-empty (so the purge does not run on one-sided nets). `sendPowerDiode` skips `isBadLink` and demand clamping. `FluidNetMK2` does the same per pressure 0..5 x priority.
- ROR: `getFunctionInfo()` returns `PREFIX_VALUE + name` / `PREFIX_FUNCTION + name + NAME_SEPARATOR + param` (params joined by `PARAM_SEPARATOR`). Consumers pass the prefix already attached: `provideRORValue(PREFIX_VALUE + name.toLowerCase(Locale.US))` (`TileEntityRadioTorchReader.java:49`) and `runRORFunction(PREFIX_FUNCTION + IRORInteractive.getCommand(cmd), IRORInteractive.getParams(cmd))` (`TileEntityRadioTorchController.java:54`; `getCommand` lowercases). So compare against `PREFIX_VALUE + "lowercase"` / `PREFIX_FUNCTION + "lowercase"` and check `params.length` before indexing (see Gotchas). `TileEntityProxyCombo` (and `BlockPWR.TileEntityBlockPWR`, to the controller) forward ROR to the core, and `TileEntityProxyCombo` also forwards OC.
- Addon hooks: `CompatExternal.registerRecipeRegisterListener` (fires only in `SerializableRecipe.initialize`'s defaults branch, NOT when a user JSON exists) and `registerFluidRegisterListener` (fires in `Fluids.init` and `reloadFluids`). `CompatExternal` also exposes `getCoreFromPos`, `getBufferedPowerFromTile`, turret target lists, warhead hooks.
- CI versioning: `build.yml` seds `RefStrings.VERSION` to `1.0.27 BETA (<days>)` and `gradle.properties` `mod_build_number`; `build.gradle` forms `1.0.27_X<n>_H261` and appends the fork revision read from `com/hbm/dbs/DBSVersion.java` (`_DBS<REVISION>`, today `1.0.27_X5778_H261_DBS1`).

### How-to

- HE consumer: extend `TileEntityMachineBase`/`TileEntityLoadedBase`, `implements IEnergyReceiverMK2`, `long power`, `getPower/setPower/getMaxPower`, `DirPos[] getConPos()`, server-side `trySubscribe(worldObj, pos)` (DirPos overload, `IEnergyReceiverMK2.java:37`) or `trySubscribe(worldObj, pos.getX(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ(), pos.getDir())` at least every 20 ticks, persist `power` in `readFromNBT`/`writeToNBT` and `serialize`/`deserialize` (calling super in each). Exemplars `tileentity/machine/TileEntityAtmosphericCompressor.java` (subscribes every tick) and `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineElectricFurnace.java` (subscribes only every 40 ticks, `TileEntityMachineElectricFurnace.java:180`, so below ~13 TPS its 3000 ms subscription lapses between heartbeats; keep new tiles at <= 20 ticks). Do not copy `TileEntityMachinePumpElectric`: neither it nor `TileEntityMachinePumpBase` (nor `TileEntityMachinePumpSteam`) writes NBT, so pump power and tanks reset on reload. Do not copy `TileEntityAtmosphericEmitter` either: its `onChunkUnload`/`serialize` skip super.
- HE provider: `implements IEnergyProviderMK2`, `tryProvide(worldObj, nx, ny, nz, dir)` per side; do not call `usePower` yourself for net transfers. Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityConverterRfHe.java`.
- Fluid machine (MK2): `implements IFluidStandardTransceiverMK2`, `FluidTank` fields, `getReceivingTanks/getSendingTanks/getAllTanks`, `trySubscribe(tank.getTankType(), worldObj, x, y, z, dir)` inputs, `tryProvide(tank, worldObj, x, y, z, dir)` outputs, `tank.writeToNBT(nbt, key)`/`serialize(buf)`. Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntitySolarBoiler.java`. Deprecated shim path (`subscribeToAllAround`/`sendFluidToAll`): `tileentity/machine/TileEntityDeuteriumExtractor.java`.
- Cable: extend `TileEntityCableBaseNT`; override `createNode()` for multi-block geometry (`new PowerNode(BlockPos...).setConnections(DirPos...)`, DirPos = neighbour position + direction toward it). The node's positions must include the tile's own xyz, because the base `updateEntity` looks the node up there and the base `invalidate()` already calls `Nodespace.destroyNode` there (no own destroy call needed). Without it you get duplicate, never-destroyed nodes (see the REDD gotcha). Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntitySubstation.java`.
- Duct: extend `TileEntityPipeBaseNT`; call `setType(FluidType)` (destroys the old-type node) never mutate `type` directly. Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityFluidValve.java`.
- New network kind: `MyNetwork extends NodeNet<R, P, GenNode>` with `update()` (runs every tick for every live net; empty-update nets must purge stale members themselves), `MyNetworkProvider implements INetworkProvider<MyNetwork>` with `THE_PROVIDER` returning a fresh net each call (the `NodeNet` constructor adds the net to `UniNodespace.activeNodeNets`, `NodeNet.java:24-26`, so never construct nets speculatively), `new GenNode<>(provider, BlockPos).setStandardConnections(x, y, z)` + `UniNodespace.createNode`; destroy with the `(world, x, y, z, provider)` overload (the `(World, GenNode)` overload NPEs when the world entry is missing). Exemplar `uninos/networkproviders/RebarNetworkProvider.java`.
- Battery item: `implements IBatteryItem` with NBT `charge` (missing tag = full). Exemplar `items/machine/ItemBattery.java`.
- Tool interaction: block `implements IToolable` (`onScrew` is dispatched on the Block, not the tile). The tool item either extends `items/tool/ItemTooling` (`new ItemTooling(ToolType.X, durability)`, which registers and calls `onScrew` from `onItemUse`) or does both itself: `ToolType.X.register(new ItemStack(this))` in the constructor (feeds only `stacksForDisplay`, i.e. `ToolType.getType` and `BlockToolConversion`) and `((IToolable) block).onScrew(world, player, x, y, z, side, fX, fY, fZ, ToolType.X)` in `onItemUse`. Exemplars `blocks/machine/MachineAutosaw.java` (block), `items/tool/ItemBlowtorch.java` (custom tool).
- Pneumatic storage: extend `TileEntityPneumaticStorageBase` (abstract; already implements `IPneumaticConnector`, `IFluidStandardReceiverMK2`, `ISlotMonitorProvider`, `IControlReceiver` (pressure cycling), `IGUIProvider`, owns the compressed-air tank and pneumatic node, allocates monitors, calls `availabilityHasChanged`/`updateMonitors`). Call `super(slotCount)`, implement `getAmountAt`, `useUpItem`, `addItem`, `setupType`, `allowTypeSetting`, `getName`, `provideContainer`/`provideGUI`, and persist your own amounts in NBT + ByteBuf (calling super). Exemplar `tileentity/network/pneumatic/TileEntityPneumoStorageMono.java`.
- Propulsion: `implements IPropulsion`; call `registerPropulsion()` only server-side (`!worldObj.isRemote`), only in orbit (`CelestialBody.inOrbit(worldObj)`) and only when facing prograde; call `unregisterPropulsion()` in `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload` (guard with a registered flag). `getTileEntity()` must return a tile with valid coords. Both calls resolve the station with `OrbitalStation.getStationFromPosition(x, z)`, which reads `SolarSystemWorldSavedData.get()` (`DimensionManager.getWorlds()[0]`), does no dimension check, and creates and saves a fallback station orbiting body 0 if none exists at that x/z. `TileEntityMachineHTRNeo` skips the `inOrbit` gate, so a south-facing one on a planet creates a phantom station. Engines are a HashSet (double registration is harmless). All five thrusters (`XenonThruster`, `HTR3`, `HTRF4`, `HTRNeo`, `LPW2`) set `hasRegistered = true` even when not prograde; this one-shot check is deliberate, not a defect: facing is the core block's metadata (`getBlockMetadata() - BlockDummyable.offset`), fixed at placement, so a retry could never succeed.
- Radar: `implements IRadarDetectableNT` (TIER constants, `canBeSeenBy`, `paramsApplicable`). Exemplar `entity/missile/EntityMissileBaseNT.java`.
- RF bridge: RF->HE `implements IEnergyProviderMK2, cofh.api.energy.IEnergyHandler` with `EnergyStorage storage` (NBT `Energy`), exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityConverterRfHe.java`. HE->RF `implements IEnergyReceiverMK2, IEnergyHandler`, trySubscribes on all sides, pushes RF into adjacent `cofh.api.energy.IEnergyReceiver` tiles itself and uses LOW priority; exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityConverterHeRf.java`.

### Gotchas

- Implementing receiver/provider/`IFluidUserMK2` forces `isLoaded()`. Extend `TileEntityLoadedBase` (and call `super.onChunkUnload()`) so nets drop you as soon as your chunk unloads. Otherwise you are dropped only after your 3000 ms subscription lapses: 1.7.10 chunk unload calls only `onChunkUnload()`, never `invalidate()`, so `isBadLink`'s `isInvalid()` stays false, and until then the net keeps calling `transferPower`/`usePower` (or the fluid equivalents) on the unloaded tile.
- `UniNodeWorld.popNode` calls `node.net.destroy()`: breaking one cable, `setType`, pylon disconnects and `TileEntityCableSwitch` tear down the whole net; it re-forms next tick and machines re-subscribe within 20 ticks.
- `UniNodespace.worlds` is keyed by World object and never cleared on unload (only `/ntmreapnetworks`); integrated-server world switches leak nodes. Nodes are not persisted; `GenNode.net` is null the first tick.
- `TileEntityPylonBase.addConnection` dereferences `Nodespace.getNode` without a null check (`TileEntityPipelineBase` guards it).
- `TileEntityBatteryBase` creates its node at `getPortPos()` but looks up/destroys at its own xyz; `TileEntityBatteryREDD` ports exclude the core position (`TileEntityBatteryREDD.java:165-172`; `TileEntityBatterySocket.java:270` includes it), so REDD recreates duplicate nodes on every tile recreation and never destroys them (ghost links until `/ntmreapnetworks`). Any new link tile must keep its own xyz among its node's positions.
- `FluidNetMK2` arrays are sized `HIGHEST_VALID_PRESSURE + 1 = 6` x priorities; pressure > 5 indexes out of bounds.
- ROR functions must check `params.length` before indexing: `getParams` returns `new String[0]` when the command has no `!` (`IRORInteractive.java:31`), and `TileEntityRadioTorchController` (L53-55) catches only `RORFunctionException` (thrown by `getCommand`/`getParams`/`parseInt`). Any other exception escapes the torch's `updateEntity` and crashes the server unless Forge's `removeErroringTileEntities` is on. `TileEntityHeaterOilburner` (L265 `setstate`, L270 `setburnrate`) and `TileEntityFluidCounterValve` (L153 `setstate`) index `params[0]` unguarded today, so a bare `setstate` on their channel crashes the server tick.
- `particleDebug` constants in `IEnergyHandlerMK2`/`IFluidUserMK2` spam `AuxParticlePacketNT` if flipped.
- `ToolType.getType` builds its map once; later `register` calls are ignored.
- Line endings: all LF in the index since the fork's normalisation commit `27811a59`. `.gitattributes` enforces it for every text file (the `* text=auto eol=lf` catch-all plus the per-extension rules; only `*.bat` checks out CRLF), and `tools/check-fork.sh` fails on any CRLF in the index. The owner's working tree was refreshed to LF on 2026-09-26 and the clone sets `core.autocrlf=false`. Merge upstream with `-Xrenormalize`.
- CI runs only on `space-travel-twopointfive`; the `1.0.27` literal in `build.yml`'s sed is separate from `gradle.properties`.

### Smells

- `PowerNetMK2.update` (L75-86) and `sendPowerDiode` subtract cumulative `energyUsed` each priority tier; `FluidNetMK2.transferFluid` (L108) has the same shape (upstream behaviour, unverified intent).
- `FluidNetMK2.transfered[]` dead; `currentTime` shared static; `IBatteryItem.emptyBattery` copies twice; redundant `getReceiverSpeed` overrides; typos in API docs.
- `TileEntityPipeBaseNT` (L121-132) redeclares a public `isLoaded` field that shadows `TileEntityLoadedBase.isLoaded`; it overrides `isLoaded()` and `onChunkUnload()` (calling super) consistently, so it works, but a read of `.isLoaded` through a `TileEntityLoadedBase` reference sees the parent field.
- `gradle.properties` credits string has mojibake (`V�r`), a doubled paren, and missing commas after two names.

## 3. Blocks: registration and generic blocks

### Purpose

`com/hbm/blocks/ModBlocks.java` (4092 lines) is the flat registry: 1116 `public static Block` fields (55 of them `@Deprecated`) plus 11 `public static Fluid` fields (L54-1410), `initializeBlock()` (L1412-2736) instantiating with fluent setters, `registerBlock()` (L2738-4042) calling `GameRegistry.registerBlock`. It runs from `MainRegistry.PreLoad` after `Fluids.init()` and before `ModItems`. The top-level package holds base classes (`BlockBase`, `BlockMulti`/`BlockEnumMulti`, `BlockDummyable`, `BlockRemap`), marker interfaces (`ITooltipProvider`, `ILookOverlay`, `IPersistentInfoProvider`, `IBlockMulti`, `IBlockMultiPass`, `IBlockSideRotation`, `ICustomBlockHighlight`, `IStepTickReceiver`, `IRadResistantBlock`, `IProxyController`, `IAnalyzable`, `ISpotlight`) and ~12 leaf blocks (BlockCoral, BlockCrop, BlockKelp, BlockVolcanoV2, ...). `generic/` has ~159 non-machine blocks, `fluid/` Forge fluids, `gas/` self-propagating gases, `rail/` NTM rails, `turret/` turret blocks, `test/` dev blocks.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockBase.java` | `setBlockName()` also sets texture to `hbm:<name>`; `setBeaconable()`/`noMobSpawn()` are unused repo-wide. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockContainerBase.java` | BlockBase + ITileEntityProvider; users: `bomb/BlockChargeBase`, `machine/PistonInserter`. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/IBlockMulti.java`, `BlockMulti.java`, `BlockEnumMulti.java`, `BlockEnums.java` | Meta-subtype contract (`rectify` = `abs(meta % count)`), enum-driven blocks (`icons '<tex>.<enum_lower>'`, lang `tile.<name>.<enum_lower>`), shared enums. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockDummyable.java` | Multiblock base (948 lines); see area 4 (which also answers the `MultiblockHandlerXR.rotate` frame). |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockRemap.java` + `items/block/ItemBlockRemap.java` | Rename compat (random tick + inventory conversion); `ModBlocks.addRemap` is the only public entry and has zero callers. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/ITooltipProvider.java`, `IPersistentInfoProvider.java`, `ILookOverlay.java` | Tooltip (`addStandardInfo` shows `tile.<name>.desc` on LSHIFT), persistent-NBT tooltip, crosshair HUD overlay (`printGeneric`). |
| `com/hbm/blocks/ModSoundType.java`, `ModSoundTypes.java`, `BlockFallingNT.java`, `MaterialGas.java` | Custom sound types (`ModSoundTypes.grate/pipe/mork/flesh/platemetal`). Name-based factories take a bare suffix and add the namespace themselves: `ModSoundType.mod("x", volume, pitch)` gives place/break `hbm:dig.x` and step `hbm:step.x`; `customPlace/customBreak/customStep/customDig("x", "<full id>", volume, pitch)` replace one sound (`customDig` replaces both place and break) and derive the rest from `x` the same way (L43-64, L90-96). Pass `"x"`, not `"hbm:x"`. `sounds.json` has no `dig.*` entries yet, so add them. Copy-based: `customPlace/customBreak/customStep/customDig(Block.soundTypeX, "<full id>", volume, pitch)` (e.g. `"hbm:step.x"`, `"hbm:block.x"`) keep the vanilla type's other sounds. `placeBreakStep(place, break, step, volume, pitch)` sets all three. Optionally chain `.enveloped(rand).pitchFunction(...)`/`.volumeFunction(...)`. Every full id must exist in `sounds.json`. Today only the copy-based forms and `placeBreakStep` are used. Falling block via `EntityFallingBlockNT`, gas material. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/generic/BlockOre.java` | `IBlockMultiPass` (pass 0 planet stone, pass 1 overlay), `IBlockMulti` (meta = `SolarSystem.Body` ordinal: `ORBIT` = 0 draws vanilla `stone` (L187-193) and is the meta the overworld `lib/HbmWorldGen` calls place, `KERBIN` = 1; 11 bodies today (`dim/SolarSystem.java:309-320`), and 4-bit block meta caps this at 16), drop tables by identity, `addValidBody/addAllBodies/addAllExcept` (tooltip only; see How-to). `damageDropped`: `ore_rare` -> chunk enum ordinal, `ore_lapis` -> 4, else 0 or `rectify(meta)`. |
| `generic/BlockOreOutgas.java`, `BlockOutgas.java`, `BlockCluster.java`, `BlockOreFluid.java`, `BlockBedrockOreTE.java` | Gas-venting ores (4- and 5-arg ctors; identity tables in `getGas()`), crystal drops, oil/gas/brine reserves, bedrock ore TE. |
| `generic/BlockHazard.java` | Radiation from `HazardSystem.getHazardLevelFromStack` in `onBlockAdded` via scheduled ticks (`tickRate` 20, not random ticks); `makeBeaconable()`, `setDisplayEffect()` must be chained BEFORE `setBlockName` (they return `BlockHazard`). Default material iron. |
| `generic/BlockEnumMultiCT.java`, `BlockNTMGlassCT.java` | Connected textures (`IBlockCT`, `CT.renderID`, `<tex>_ct` fragments). |
| `generic/BlockMultiSlab.java`, `BlockMultiSlabMeta.java`, `BlockGenericStairs.java` + `items/block/ItemModSlab.java` | Multi-material slabs/stairs; static `recipeGen` lists consumed by `CraftingManager` L90-95 (only the single-slab instance pushes); `ItemModSlab` hard-codes pairs. |
| `generic/BlockDepth.java`, `BlockSpeedy.java`, `BlockTint.java`, `DecoBlock.java`, `BlockDecoModel.java`, `BlockDecoContainer.java` | ITooltipProvider exemplar; IStepTickReceiver exemplar; tinted variants. `DecoBlock` picks one of three static render ids by identity (steel_wall/corner/beam, others -1) and keeps its rotation in meta 2-5. `BlockDecoModel` keeps its rotation in meta bits 2-3 and its subtype in bits 0-1 (L58 packs `rot << 2` with the item damage; at most 4 enum constants). It has a single static `renderID`, bound in `ClientProxy` L871 to a `RenderBlockDecoModel` that carries deco_computer's OBJ, so a new model needs its own render id and handler. `BlockDecoContainer` is the TE variant (render type -1, TESR). |
| `blocks/fluid/GenericFluid.java`, `GenericFluidBlock.java`, `GenericFiniteFluid.java`, `AcidBlock.java` etc. | Forge fluid + `BlockFluidClassic` pairs. Only mud/acid/toxic/corium use dedicated `MaterialLiquid` constants; schrabidic uses `Material.water`, lava blocks `Material.lava`. `GenericFluidBlock.onEntityCollidedWithBlock` only damages for `sulfuric_acid_block`. |
| `blocks/gas/BlockGasBase.java`, `BlockGasRadon.java`, `BlockGasFlammable.java` | Invisible (`renderType -1`) replaceable gases; `updateTick` -> `tryMove(getFirstDirection)`/`getSecondDirection`, sets `world.scheduledUpdatesAreImmediate = false`. |
| `blocks/rail/IRailNTM.java`, `IRenderBlock.java` (@Deprecated but load-bearing), `RailStandardStraight.java`, `BlockRailWaypointSystem.java` | Train rail contract (`TrackGauge`, `RailContext`), rail ISBRH id, `RailDef.nodes`-based curves. |
| `blocks/turret/TurretBaseNT.java`, `TurretChekhov.java`, `TurretBase.java` | BlockDummyable turret base (dims `{0,0,1,0,1,0}`); 9 turrets extend it, `TurretArty`/`TurretHIMARS` extend `BlockDummyable` directly, `TurretSentry`/`TurretSentryDamaged` extend `BlockContainer`; `TurretBase` is dead (zero subclasses). |
| `items/block/ItemBlockBase.java`, `ItemBlockLore.java` | Default ItemBlock wiring `IBlockMulti`, `ITooltipProvider`, `IPersistentInfoProvider` (tag `persistent`); item icon = `block.getIcon(1, meta)` (top face). `ItemBlockLore` extends `ItemBlockBase` and adds `tile.<name>.desc`. Vanilla-derived (no dispatch): `ItemBlockMeta`, `ItemBlockNamedMeta`, `ItemCustomMachine`, `ItemTrapBlock`, `ItemGlyphBlock` (all `items/block/`), `items/special/ItemOreBlock`, `items/bomb/ItemPrototypeBlock`, and `ItemModSlab` (an `ItemSlab`). |
| `inventory/OreDictManager.java` | `DictFrame` fluent ore-dict + hazard registration: `.block()`, `.ore()`, `.oreAll()` (wildcard meta), `.oreNether()`, `.rad()`. |
| `main/ClientProxy.java` L835-905 | `registerBlockRenderer()`: `RenderISBRHUniversal` first, then ~60 legacy per-block handlers under `/// STOP DOING THIS ///`. |
| `render/block/ISBRHUniversal.java`, `RenderBlockMultipass.java` | Modern ISBRH contract (block implements `renderInventoryBlock`/`renderWorldBlock`, returns `ISBRHUniversal.renderID`); multipass handler (`currentPass` static). |

### Patterns

- Declaration/registration split: `x = new X(Material.rock).setBlockName("x").setCreativeTab(MainRegistry.blockTab).setHardness(f).setResistance(f).setBlockTextureName(RefStrings.MODID + ":x");` then `register(x)` / `GameRegistry.registerBlock(x, x.getUnlocalizedName())`. Registry name `hbm:tile.<name>`.
- Registration forms (counts): 2-arg `GameRegistry.registerBlock` (~540, vanilla ItemBlock), `registerBlock(b, ItemBlockBase.class, ...)` (~122) or `register(b)` (~379), `register(b, Class)` (~10), explicit classes `ItemBlockBlastInfo` (38), `ItemBlockLore` (11), `ItemModSlab` (8), `ItemBlockStorageCrate` (6), `ItemOreBlock`, `ItemBlockMeta`, `ItemBlockNamedMeta`, `ItemBlockColoredConcrete`, `ItemTrapBlock`, `ItemPrototypeBlock`, `ItemGlyphBlock`, `ItemCustomMachine`.
- Bases that do NOT extend `BlockBase` (explicit `setBlockTextureName` needed): `BlockOre`, `BlockHazard`, `BlockGasBase`, `BlockDummyable`, `BlockMachineBase`, `BlockTint`, `BlockNoSpawn`, `BlockFallingNT`, `BlockDepth`, `BlockSpeedy`. Not needed: `GenericFluidBlock`/`GenericFiniteFluid` register their icons from the constructor still/flowing names, and `BlockMultiSlab`/`BlockGenericStairs` force `hbm:concrete` and take their icons from the source blocks.
- Identity-driven behaviour: `BlockOre`, `BlockCluster`, `BlockDepthOre`, `BlockStepEffect`, `BlockOreOutgas`, `BlockOutgas`, `DecoBlock`, `MeltedFlesh` branch on `this == ModBlocks.x`; a new instance gets default behaviour until a branch is added.
- Hazard blocks: radiation comes from `HazardSystem`, by one of two routes. Route 1 is an ore-dict key via `DictFrame`: `.rad(x)` must come BEFORE `.block(block)`, because `registerStack` registers the hazards collected so far (`OreDictManager` ~L1062-1066); the multiplier is `HazardRegistry.block = 10F`. Route 2 is a direct `HazardSystem.register(block|stack, makeData(RADIATION, x))` in `HazardRegistry` (e.g. `block_corium` L252, `sellafield` metas L255-260). With neither, the block is inert.
- Forge fluids: `x_fluid = new GenericFluid("x_fluid").setDensity(..); FluidRegistry.registerFluid(x_fluid); x_block = new GenericFluidBlock(x_fluid, Material.water, "x_still", "x_flowing").setDamage(...)...` (this is the Forge system; NTM machine fluids are `inventory/fluid/Fluids` FluidTypes).
- Render ids: `public static int renderID = RenderingRegistry.getNextAvailableRenderId();` on the block or a shared interface, `getRenderType()` returns it, matching handler registered in `ClientProxy.registerBlockRenderer`. Modern path: implement `ISBRHUniversal`, no registration needed. `-1` = TESR-only/invisible. Allocating the id in a common block's static initializer is safe on a dedicated server, going by the Forge 10.13.4.1614 bytecode (javap): `RenderingRegistry`'s static init and constructor only allocate a HashMap/ArrayList and set `nextRenderId = 42`, and `getNextAvailableRenderId()` only increments that int, so no client-only class is touched. This rests on the bytecode, not on a missing `@SideOnly` (FML's client-package classes, `FMLClientHandler` included, carry none). Only the ISBRH handler classes and their `RenderingRegistry.registerBlockHandler` calls must stay in `ClientProxy`; a dedicated-server start remains the final confirmation.
- Look overlays: `ILookOverlay.printHook` dispatched from `ModEventHandlerClient` (~L226) gated on `ClientConfig.DODD_RBMK_DIAGNOSTIC` (default true). On a block hit a held `ILookOverlay` item's `printHook` runs instead of the block's (L234-239); on an entity hit the entity's (L254-258). `SHOW_BLOCK_META_OVERLAY` (L245) sits inside the same gate.
- Conditional blocks: guard both at init (`Loader.isModLoaded("OpenComputers")`) and at registration (`Compat.MOD_OC`).
- Creative tabs: `blockTab`, `machineTab`, `nukeTab`, `missileTab`, `weaponTab`, `partsTab`, `controlTab`, `templateTab`, `consumableTab`; `null` hides.
- Naming families: pick the base by the closest existing family and name the class after it: `BlockBase` (plain; `setBlockName` also sets the texture), `BlockGeneric`, `BlockEnumMulti`/`BlockMulti` (meta subtypes), `BlockContainerBase`/`BlockMachineBase` (single-block machine with TE), `BlockDummyable` (multiblock; classes are `Machine*`), `BlockHazard`, `BlockOre*`, `BlockGasBase`, `BlockFallingNT`, `BlockMultiSlab`/`BlockGenericStairs`, `DecoBlock*`. Field name = unlocalized name = registry name (`hbm:tile.<name>`) = texture (`hbm:<name>`), and the class family mirrors it (`machine_x` -> `MachineX`, `TileEntityMachineX`, `ContainerMachineX`, `GUIMachineX`, `RenderX`).

### How-to

- Plain block: field; init chain copied from `gneiss_brick` (~L1487) using `BlockGeneric`; `register(x)`; `textures/blocks/x.png`; `tile.x.name`; ore dict via `DictFrame.block(x)`. Exemplar `generic/BlockGeneric.java`.
- Enum subtypes: enum in `BlockEnums.java`; `new BlockEnumMulti(Material.rock, MyEnum.class, true, true)` (copy `vinyl_tile` ~L1774); register with an `ItemBlockBase`-derived class; textures `x.<constant_lower>.png`; lang `tile.x.<constant_lower>.name`. CT variant `BlockEnumMultiCT` + `_ct.png`. Exemplar `generic/BlockMeteorOre.java`.
- Ore: `new BlockOre(Material.rock)` (copy `ore_titanium` ~L1429) or `BlockOreOutgas`. Add a `BlockOre.getItemDropped` branch only if the ore drops something other than itself (`damageDropped` then returns 0 on its own). Register with `ItemBlockBase.class`. The texture is the overlay only (pass 0 draws the body's stone). Add `.oreAll(ore_x)` in `OreDictManager`. Spawning is separate: call `DungeonToolbox.generateOre(world, rand, x, z, veins, size, minY, variance, ModBlocks.ore_x, meta, stone)` in `lib/HbmWorldGen` (overworld, meta 0), in `dim/WorldGeneratorCelestial.generateNTMOres` (every non-overworld body) or in the body's `WorldGenerator*` (meta = `CelestialBody.getMeta(world)`, stone = `((WorldProviderCelestial) world.provider).getStone()`, e.g. `WorldGeneratorIke` L52-59). `BlockOre.addValidBody(ModBlocks.ore_x, Body.X)`, placed in that generator's constructor, only feeds the "Can be found on" tooltip (shown when `SpaceConfig.showOreLocations` is on); it spawns nothing.
- Radioactive block: `new BlockHazard().makeBeaconable().setDisplayEffect(ExtDisplayEffect.RADFOG).setBlockName(...)...` (copy `block_uranium` ~L1551 / `block_schrabidium` ~L1597); `.block(x)` on a `DictFrame` with `.rad()`. Upstream defect: `BlockHazard.rad` is a per-type field set only in `onBlockAdded` (L138-146), and chunk loading never calls `onBlockAdded`. After a restart the field is 0 until some block of that type is placed. Persisted scheduled ticks reach `updateTick` with `rad == 0`, which neither irradiates nor reschedules (L121-127), so existing blocks stop emitting. `BlockHazardFalling` has the same bug; `BlockSellafield` avoids it with a constructor-set `rad` and random ticks. Test across a restart. The fix is to compute `rad` lazily in `updateTick` (or in the constructor/on first use) instead of only in `onBlockAdded`.
- Forge fluid: fields ~L1302-1342 (sulfuric acid L1330-1331), init ~L2618-2667 (copy sulfuric acid ~L2646), register in the `//Fluids` block ~L3951-3964 (sulfuric acid L3959), textures `x_still.png`/`x_flowing.png`. `GenericFluidBlock.setDamage(...)` only takes effect for `sulfuric_acid_block` (identity gate in `onEntityCollidedWithBlock`, B-041), so a new damaging fluid needs that fix or its own subclass.
- Gas: subclass `BlockGasBase` (ctor `super(r, g, b)`, `getFirstDirection`, `onEntityCollidedWithBlock`, `updateTick` decay); init copy `gas_radon` ~L2596; spawn via `getGas()` branches or `world.setBlock`. Exemplar `gas/BlockGasRadon.java`.
- Custom ISBRH: implement `ISBRHUniversal`, `getRenderType() { return ISBRHUniversal.renderID; }`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false, implement both render methods (must implement `renderInventoryBlock`; `RenderISBRHUniversal.shouldRender3DInInventory` is always true and casts unconditionally). Exemplar `generic/BlockSandbags.java`, `generic/BlockRebar.java` (uses `RenderBlocksNT.INSTANCE.setWorld(world)`).
- Tooltip/overlay: `ITooltipProvider.addStandardInfo` (needs `ItemBlockBase`; shows `tile.<name>.desc` on LSHIFT), `ItemBlockLore.class` for a code-free `.desc` (shown whenever the key resolves, no LSHIFT gate, `$`-split, one base key for all metas), `ILookOverlay.printGeneric`. Exemplars: `generic/BlockAlgaeFilm.java` (addStandardInfo + printHook/printGeneric, `register(algae_film)`); `generic/BlockDepth.java` for a custom tooltip line.
- Slabs/stairs: `new BlockMultiSlab(null, mat, blocks...)` plus the double `new BlockMultiSlab(single, mat, same blocks...)` (copy `concrete_slab` ~L1744); at most 8 source blocks per slab (`meta & 7`); use `BlockMultiSlabMeta` when the sources need metas. Add the pair to `ItemModSlab.shittyFuckingHackSingle/Double` and register BOTH blocks with `ItemModSlab.class`. Lang is per material: `tile.<slab>.<source block name without tile.>.name` (e.g. `tile.concrete_slab.concrete_smooth.name`). Stairs: `new BlockGenericStairs(block, meta)` plus `tile.<stairs>.name`. Crafting recipes (3 blocks -> 6 slabs, 6 blocks -> 4 stairs) are generated from `recipeGen` (`CraftingManager.AddCraftingRec` L90-95); do not add them by hand.
- Rename/remove: never change `setBlockName` in place; `addRemap("old", newBlock, meta)` (unexercised path, verify in-game) or `ignoreMappings.add("hbm:tile.old")` in `handleMissingMappings`; or keep the field `@Deprecated` (55 such fields).

### Gotchas

- `IBlockMulti`, `ITooltipProvider`, `IPersistentInfoProvider` only work through `ItemBlockBase` (sole `instanceof ITooltipProvider` site); ~540 blocks use the vanilla ItemBlock.
- `ModBlocks.register(Block)` and `register(Block, Class)` are private (L4044-4050). Code outside `ModBlocks` (e.g. `com/hbm/dbs`) calls `GameRegistry.registerBlock(b, ItemBlockBase.class, b.getUnlocalizedName())` directly during `PreLoad`, or widens their visibility.
- `BlockEnumMulti.getIcon` wraps with `meta % icons.length`; `rectify`/`grabEnumSafely` wrap negatives too.
- `BlockMultiSlab`/`BlockGenericStairs` force `setBlockTextureName(hbm:concrete)`; icons come from the source blocks.
- `BlockMultiSlabMeta` fills `recipeGen` from the varargs `metas[i]` (L28), not `this.metas[i]`, so a single-slab constructor call with fewer metas than slab materials throws `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` at init.
- `GenericFiniteFluid` has static `stillIcon`/`flowingIcon`. Today only `corium_block` (`CoriumFinite`) fills them. `concrete_liquid` (ModBlocks L2658-2659) is constructed but never registered: there is no `GameRegistry.registerBlock` call and its Fluid never reaches `FluidRegistry`, so its `registerBlockIcons` never runs and the block is dead (the collision described in B-040 cannot happen today). Settled: delete the block and its `GenericFluid`, keeping `concrete_liquid.png` for `BlockRebar` (B-040, Phase 7). A second registered finite fluid would overwrite the pair. `CoriumBlock` is never instantiated, but `CoriumFluid.getStillIcon()` returns its static icons (null).
- `GenericFluid.getStillIcon()`/`getFlowingIcon()` return `this.block.getIcon(...)` (L22-29). This works because Forge's `BlockFluidBase` constructor calls `fluid.setBlock(this)`; a `GenericFluid` without a block would NPE in any tank renderer.
- `ItemModSlab` with a missing pair creates an `ItemSlab` with null slab references (NPE on naming/placement).
- `ModSoundTypes` static init dereferences `MainRegistry.instance.rand` (L9, L13), so the class must not be touched before FML has injected the mod instance (fine from `PreLoad`).
- `BlockGasBase.updateTick` flips a world-global flag. Gas spawn sites also include ZirnoxDestroyed, RBMKDebrisBurning/Radiating, BlockGasMeltdown, YellowBarrel, BlockOreBasalt.
- `ModBlocks.getDropsWithoutDamage()` exists because `damageDropped`-based meta breaks creative middle-click.
- `BlockRemap` ctor is protected, uses `Material.tnt` and random ticks (unloaded chunks never convert). It has no `registerBlockIcons` override, so a remap block requests a missing-icon texture (log noise only; `getIcon` delegates to the target).

### Smells

- `ModBlocks.java:1853` `//TODO: dear god` over 24 @Deprecated `deco_pipe_*`; `:445` ike_stone comment; ~L3117 vinyl_tile comment; `generic/BlockCrate.java:26` @Spaghetti + TODO loot pools; `BlockNTMGlassPane.java:22` auto-generated stub; `BlockStepEffect` identity grab-bag; `CoriumFinite.updateTick` try/catch(ClassCastException) CoFH band-aid; `WarController.java` (a `BlockMachineBase`) lives in the top-level package.

### Open questions

- Fix the `BlockHazard`/`BlockHazardFalling` restart defect (see How-to, radioactive block)? It changes existing worlds: blocks that have been inert since a restart would start emitting chunk radiation again.

## 4. Blocks: machines, bombs, networks (BlockDummyable)

### Purpose

`blocks/machine/` (307 files incl. albion/fusion/pile/rbmk), `blocks/bomb/` (50) and `blocks/network/` (71 incl. pneumatic). Blocks are thin: multiblock footprint and rotation (`BlockDummyable`), TE creation by metadata, right-click forwarding to the GUI system (`FMLNetworkHandler.openGui` -> `GUIHandler` -> `IGUIProvider` on the TE), break/drop/NBT persistence. 163 classes under `blocks/machine/` are `BlockDummyable`: 147 direct (including abstract `RBMKBase`) and 16 indirect (14 RBMK classes via `RBMKBase`/`RBMKPipedBase`/`RBMKRod`, `BlockOrbitalStationLauncher` via `BlockOrbitalStation`, `MachinePrecAss` via `MachineAssemblyMachine`). `BlockPWR` and `BlockICF` are plain `BlockContainer` + `IBlockCT` blocks, not BlockDummyable. `blocks/bomb/` has 4 BlockDummyable classes (the LaunchPad family) and `blocks/network/` has 9.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockDummyable.java` | Metadata scheme (`offset = 10`, `extra = 6`): 0-5 plain dummy (ForgeDirection from the core toward the dummy along the fill chain, y->x->z), 6-11 "extra" port dummy (gets a proxy TE), 12-15 core (`dir.ordinal() + 10`, horizontal only). `onBlockPlacedBy` placement, `findCore`/`findCoreRec`, `checkRequirement`/`fillSpace`, `makeExtra`/`removeExtra`, `breakBlock` cascade + inventory spill, `standardOpenBehavior(id)` (protected; returns true when sneaking), `bounding` hitboxes, `drawPlacementHighlight`, `getRenderType() = -1`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false. Static globals `safeRem`, `overrideTileMeta`; instance scratch state `positions`, `internalPlayers`. |
