### Patterns

- Registration: append `addEntity`/`addMob` at the end of the respective block; lang `entity.hbm.<name>.name` (prefix from FML `registerModEntity`); renderer via `RenderingRegistry.registerEntityRenderingHandler` in `ClientProxy` (`RenderEmpty` for invisible; a class without one inherits the nearest superclass renderer, which for a plain `Entity` is vanilla `RenderEntity`, a white bounding box; explosion drivers have none and fall back to it).
- DataWatcher slots: non-living from 10; siege 12-16; UFO base 17-19; glyphids 16-18; timed clouds 16; carts 23; rail dummies 3-5.
- Progressive explosion drivers: `EntityExplosionChunkloading` subclasses. MK3/Balefire/TomBlast own column algorithms with `boolean update()` and `saveToNbt/readFromNbt(nbt, prefix)` and call `update()` `speed` times per tick (`speed` grows by 1 each tick); MK5 drives an `IExplosionRay` through `cacheChunksTick`/`destructionTick(BombConfig.mk5)` and does not persist it. Only MK5 (`statFac*`) and MK3 (`statFacFleija`) have factories that return the entity for the caller to spawn; Balefire/TomBlast are built with `new` + fields; `EntityNukeTorex.statFac*` spawn internally and return void.
- Client FX: `PacketThreading.createAllAroundThreadedPacket(new AuxParticlePacketNT(nbt, x, y, z), TargetPoint)` with `nbt.type` (`muke`, `tinytot`, `plasmablast`, `tau`, `giblets`, `vanillaburst`, `tower`, `depress`), or `MainRegistry.proxy.effectNT(nbt)` on the client; shaped visuals via `ExplosionCreator.composeEffect*`.
- Boss convention: `IBossDisplayData`, `IRadiationImmune`/`ISuffocationImmune`, `canDespawn() false`, achievements on death.
- Tunables: `config/MobConfig` (`enableMaskman`/`maskmanDelay`/`maskmanMinRad`/`maskmanUnderground`, `enableRaids`/`raid*`, `enableElementals`/`elemental*`, `enableDucks`, `enableMobGear`/`enableMobWeapons`/`mobWeaponSootReduction`, `enableMunCows`, hives: `enableHives`, `hiveSpawn`, `scoutThreshold`, `scoutSwarmSpawnChance`, `largeHiveChance`/`largeHiveThreshold`, `swarmCooldown`, `baseSwarmSize`, `swarmScalingMult`, `sootStep`, `spawnMax`, `enableInfestation`/`baseInfestChance`, `targetingThreshold`, `rampant*`, `waypointDebug`), `config/BombConfig` (per-nuke radii `gadgetRadius`..`aSchrabRadius`, `mk5`, `blastSpeed`, `falloutRange`, `fDelay`, `limitExplosionLifespan`, `chunkloading` and `explosionAlgorithm` (both inert on the active path; read only by the dead `ExplosionNukeRayParallelized`)), `GlyphidStats.GLYPHID_STATS_NT`/`GLYPHID_STATS_70K` (`StatBundle` per variant, `getStats()` picks the active set, hard-wired to NT at `GlyphidStats.java:13-14`). `EntityBulletBaseMK4` ctors: `(world, shooter, config, damage, spread, x, y, z, mx, my, mz)` (submunitions), `(shooter, config, baseDamage, spread, sideOffset, heightOffset, frontOffset)` (from the shooter's eyes; guns via `Lego`, mobs), `(world, config, baseDamage, spread, yaw, pitch)` (turrets and grenade fragments: angles in radians, pitch negated; sets no position, the caller must). `RocketStruct.RocketStage.zipWatchable()` packs one stage into a `Pair<Integer, Integer>` for the DataWatcher (ids are bounded by that packing; `unzipWatchable` reverses it).

### How-to

- Hostile mob: `EntityMob` with `tasks`/`targetTasks` added in the ctor AND `isAIEnabled()` returning true (vanilla default false silently falls back to legacy `updateEntityActionState`; see `EntityMaskMan` L106), `applyEntityAttributes`, drops, NBT. `EntityUFOBase` (flying) and `EntityGlyphid` use legacy `updateEntityActionState` overrides (call super first) instead of tasks; `EntityFish` is a passive `EntityWaterMob` base. `addMob(...)` at the end (tracking range fixed at 80, update interval 3); optional `addSpawn`, or a `SpawnListEntry` added to the `monsters`/`creatures`/`waterCreatures` list in a celestial biome ctor (`getSpawnableList` returns a copy there); lang; `Render*` in `ClientProxy.registerEntityRenderer`. Exemplar `mob/EntityMaskMan.java`.
- Glyphid variant: subclass with `getSkin`/`getScale`/`applyEntityAttributes`/`getStats`; add a `protected StatBundle statsX` field and `getX()` accessor to the abstract `GlyphidStats` and assign it in BOTH the `GlyphidStats70K` and `GlyphidStatsNT` ctors (`getStats()` is hard-wired to NT); `addMob`; the renderer is inherited from `EntityGlyphid` (`RenderGlyphid`) unless you register your own; `MobConfig` chance triple `{base, sootScale, sootThreshold}` + its `createConfigIntList` line in `MobConfig.loadFromConfig` + `spawnMap.add(new Pair<>(EntityGlyphidX::new, MobConfig.xChance))` in `BlockGlyphidSpawner`. Exemplar `EntityGlyphidNuclear.java`.
- Siege tier: add a `public static SiegeTier X;` field and append `X = new SiegeTier(health, "name").addDrop(...).setDR(..).setDT(..)...;` at the END of `SiegeTier.registerTiers()` (the setters are private, so the chain must stay inside `SiegeTier`; id = registration order, persisted as `siegeTier`); add textures `textures/entity/ufo_siege_<name>.png` (RenderSiegeUFO L53) and `textures/entity/siege_craft_<name>.png` (RenderSiegeCraft L106); add it to the rolls in `CBT_Invasion.spawnAttempt` (L273, L284-291). The `coin_siege` item was removed (`ModItems` L1117 commented out; `MainRegistry` L900 ignoreMappings).
- Effect/logic entity: extend `Entity`, DataWatcher ids >= 10, `onUpdate` with `isRemote` guards, NBT (or non-persistent via `writeToNBTOptional() false`), fullbright `getBrightnessForRender() 15728880`; `addEntity(class, name, range[, false])`; register `RenderEmpty` for invisible entities in `ClientProxy.registerEntityRenderer`: without a renderer the class inherits the nearest superclass renderer, which for a plain `Entity` is vanilla `RenderEntity` (a white bounding box; the explosion drivers currently fall back to it). Exemplar `effect/EntityEMPBlast.java` (it runs `onUpdate` on both sides unguarded).
- Chunk-loading explosion: extend `EntityExplosionChunkloading`; write an algorithm class with `boolean update()` + `saveToNbt/readFromNbt(nbt, prefix)`; in `onUpdate` call `loadChunk(floor(posX/16), floor(posZ/16))` and run the algorithm only under `!worldObj.isRemote`; call `clearChunkLoader()` before every `setDead()` (Forge never releases a dead entity's ticket); persist state in `read/writeEntityFromNBT`; add a `statFacX(world, x, y, z, range)` factory that sets position/range and calls `loadChunk`. Exemplar `logic/EntityNukeExplosionMK3.java` (L126, L162-163, `statFacFleija` L210). Counter-examples: `EntityBalefire` (no `loadChunk`, no factory, unguarded client loop) and `EntityTomBlast` (no `clearChunkLoader`, L82).
- Conventional explosion (server side only; `explode()` has no `isRemote` guard): `new ExplosionVNT(world, x, y, z, size[, exploder])`, then `setBlockAllocator(new BlockAllocatorStandard(res))`, `setBlockProcessor(new BlockProcessorStandard().setNoDrop()[.withBlockEffect(...)])`, `setEntityProcessor(new EntityProcessorCross(nodeDist).withRangeMod(1.5F))`, `setPlayerProcessor(new PlayerProcessorStandard())`, then either `setSFX(new ExplosionEffectStandard())` or a separate `ExplosionCreator.composeEffect*` call, and `explode()`. Forge `ExplosionEvent.Start` is never posted; `Detonate` fires only from `EntityProcessorCross`/`EntityProcessorStandard`, and the block processor works on the allocator's own set, so listeners cannot veto blocks. Exemplar `blocks/bomb/BlockCrashedBomb.java` L104-111 (inside `if(!world.isRemote)` L91).
- Nuclear explosion (server side only): `world.spawnEntityInWorld(EntityNukeExplosionMK5.statFac(world, radius, x, y, z))` (+ `statFacNoRad`, `.moreFallout(n)`; `statFacSalted` currently behaves like `statFac` because MK5 never passes `salted` to `EntityFalloutRain`); cloud `EntityNukeTorex.statFacStandard(world, x, y, z, radius)` or `statFac(..., type)`; mini-nuke `ExplosionNukeSmall.explode(world, x, y, z, PARAMS_MEDIUM)`; antischrabidium `EntityNukeExplosionMK3.statFacFleija(...)`, spawned only `if(!ex.isDead)` (field disturbers within 300 blocks cancel it); balefire `new EntityBalefire(world)` + `setPosition` + `destructionRange` (+ `.antimatter()`). Exemplar `mob/EntityCreeperNuclear.java`.
- Minecart: `EntityMinecartNTM` subclass with ctors `(World)` and `(World, x, y, z, EnumCartBase[, ItemStack])`; override `getCartItem()` (`ItemModMinecart.createCartItem(getBase(), EnumMinecart.X)`) and the client-only `renderSpecialContent(RenderNeoCart)` for the load; APPEND an `EnumMinecart` constant (ordinal = item damage) listing its allowed `EnumCartBase`s, plus a `case` in `ItemModMinecart.createMinecart`'s switch (~L241); texture `textures/items/cart_overlay.<name>.png`, lang `item.cart.<name>.name`; `EntityMappings.addEntity(..., 250, false)`; no renderer needed (`RenderNeoCart` is registered for `EntityMinecartNTM` and inherited); `IGUIProvider` with the entity id as x if it has a GUI. Exemplar `cart/EntityMinecartSemtex.java`.
- Train car: extend `EntityRailCarBase`, `EntityRailCarCargo` (inventory), `EntityRailCarRidable` (implements `getCurrentSpeed`; adds abstract `getPoweredAcceleration`, `getPassivBrake`, `shouldUseEngineBrake`, `getMaxPoweredSpeed`, `canAccelerate`, `getRiderSeatPosition`, `getPassengerSeats`) or `EntityRailCarElectric` (+ `getMaxPower`, `getPowerConsumption`); implement `getMaxRailSpeed`, `getGauge`, `getLengthSpan`, `getCollisionSpan` (and `getCurrentSpeed` when not Ridable), plus the dummy/coupling/seat overrides `TrainCargoTram` shows; keep a public `(World)` ctor (ItemTrain instantiates by reflection and swallows failures, L75); APPEND an `ItemTrain.EnumTrainType` entry naming the class (drives the spawn item and its stats tooltip; ordinal = item damage; texture `textures/items/train.<enum_lower>.png`, lang `item.train.<enum_lower>.name`); `EntityMappings.addEntity(..., 250, false)` (trains sync yaw/pitch through `motionX/Y` with `velocityChanged`); renderer in `ClientProxy`; lang `entity.hbm.<name>.name`. Exemplar `train/TrainCargoTram.java` (+ `TrainCargoTramTrailer`).
- AI task: `EntityAIBase` subclass in `mob/ai/` (`shouldExecute`/`startExecuting`/`updateTask`), added in the mob ctor via `tasks.addTask(priority, ...)`/`targetTasks`; tasks only run if the host's `isAIEnabled()` returns true (the `EntityLiving` default is false). `EntityAIFireGun` drives held sedna guns through `handleKeybind(host, null, ...)` (null-inventory `LambdaContext`); beware its `updateState` switch falls through (L103-107: FIRING also presses RELOAD and then clears all binds; firing only works because `updateTask` re-presses the trigger at L80-83), so do not copy that part. Exemplar `mob/ai/EntityAIFireGun.java`.

### Gotchas

- `EntityMappings` registers `EntityCloudFleijaRainbow` and `EntityCloudSolinium` under the same name `entity_cloud_rainbow`; FML's string mapping is overwritten, so a saved Rainbow cloud reloads as Solinium.
- Siege tier ids, `SolarSystem.Body` ordinals and spawn-egg ids are persisted; FML entity network ids are not. Egg ids are assigned from 500 in `addMob` order (skipping ids other mods hold) and stored as vanilla `spawn_egg` damage, so only ever append `addMob` lines.
- `ExplosionNT`, `ExplosionNukeSmall`, `ExplosionLarge.explode*` are @Deprecated but live. The @Deprecated `EntityProcessorStandard` is still constructed at 12 sites (`makeStandard`/`makeAmat`, `EntityGlyphidNuclear`, `EntityCreeperFlesh/Gold/Volatile`, `EntityBulletBaseNT`, `BlockChargeC4`, `MachineOilWell`, `TileEntityDysonReceiver` x2, `TileEntityHeatBoiler`).
- `EntityFireLingering`, `BoundingBoxDummyEntity`, `SeatDummyEntity` are non-persistent; `EntityRailCarBase` writes no NBT in the base class.
- `ExplosionNukeGeneric.isExplosionExempt` exempts ocelots, mod projectiles and creative players; `EntityCreeperNuclear` guards `isDead`.
- Other `com.hbm.entity.logic.IChunkLoader` implementors: `EntityPlaneBase`, `EntityMissileBaseNT` (all NT missiles), `EntityMissileCustom`, `EntityMissileAntiBallistic`, `EntityArtilleryShell`, `EntityArtilleryRocket`, `EntityBulletBaseMK4CL`, `EntityDeliveryDrone` (`CommandDebugChunkLoad` uses vanilla's unrelated storage `IChunkLoader`).
- Ticket leaks: Forge never releases a dead entity's ticket, so a chunk loader that dies without `clearChunkLoader()` keeps its chunks forced until the world unloads: `EntityTomBlast` (L82), a cancelled `statFacFleija` (MK3 L236-237 only calls `setDead()`), and any `EntityExplosionChunkloading` constructed on the server but never spawned (its `entityInit` already forced chunk (0,0)). `EntityPlaneBase` copies the (0,0) forcing (`entityInit`/`init` L71-86) but its `loadNeighboringChunks` (L198-205) unforces every ticket chunk on the first server tick, and its `setDead()` override calls `clearChunkLoader()` (L174-176).
- `BulletConfig.setKnockback` mutates and returns the shared static config (`BulletConfig.java:121`; default `knockbackMult` 0.1F, L61), so mob code that calls it inline changes the round for every shooter, players included, from the first mob shot on: `EntityAIBehemothGun:88` (`XFactory762mm.r762_ap`), `EntityBFAngel:445,465` (`XFactoryEnergy.energy_tesla_overcharge`), `EntitySiegeUFO:138` (`energy_emerald_overcharge`); `EntityBFAngel:486` (`flame_balefire`) is a no-op because that config is already 0 (`XFactoryFlamer.java:121`).
- Entity GUIs opened with the entity id as x: `GUIHandler.getGUIProvider` (L29-43) checks the TileEntity and Block at (x, y, z) and then the held item before the entity with id x, so a held `IGUIProvider` item shadows the entity's GUI.
- `EntitySiegeTunneler`'s rant about EntityCreature sync (L16-24) is explained by the missing registration: FML only tracks registered classes (`tryTrackingEntity`) and vanilla's `EntityTracker` fallback tracks only `IAnimals` (which `EntityMob` gets through `IMob`), so the unregistered `EntityCreature` tunneler is never sent to clients; registered `EntityCreature`s such as `EntityBOTPrimeHead` sync normally, so registering it (B-187) would fix sync without a workaround. Its renderer also loads `textures/entity/siege_drill_<tier>.png` (`RenderSiegeTunneler.java:51`), but only `siege_drill.png` exists.
- Smells: `EntityBOTPrimeHead.java:29,68` TODOs; `EntityBurrowingBase.java:62` TODO; `ExplosionChaos.java:35`; `ExplosionNukeSmall.java:70` TODO VNT; `ExplosionLarge` double import; `EntityFalloutRain(World, int)` (L38-42) has an unused `maxAge` parameter and does not set `ignoreFrustumCheck` (harmless, not a defect: the class has no lifetime, the client copy is always built with the one-arg ctor, and only MK3's unused waste mode calls it, L192); `EntitySiegeUFO.updateEntityActionState` calls `approachPosition(20)` in its retreat branch (L93) before `super.updateEntityActionState()` (L101), which zeroes motion (`EntityUFOBase` L46-48), so the motion set by the L93 call is discarded and retreat movement comes only from the later `approachPosition(speed)` at L164 (run while `courseChangeCooldown > 0`); `items/special/ItemSiegeCoin` is never instantiated.

---

## 13. Hazards, radiation, pollution, neutron, atmosphere, compat, saved data

### Purpose

Item-carried hazards (`hazard/`), per-chunk world radiation (`handler/radiation/` with pluggable backends), regional pollution (`handler/pollution/`), the neutron nodespace (area 6), the Space atmosphere-blob system (`handler/atmosphere/`), glue handlers (hazmat ratings, armor mods, boss spawns, Bobmazon, dispensers, fuel, buckets, multiblock helpers), compat gates (OC in `CompatHandler`, AE2, ForgeMicroblock IMC, deprecated inbound IMC, GTNH-NEI outbound) and `WorldSavedData` classes (`saveddata/`). Radiation reaches entities through `util/ContaminationUtil` and `HbmLivingProps`.

### Patterns

- Fuel hazard registrars (all `private static` in `HazardRegistry`, so new fuels are registered inside `registerItems()`): `registerRBMKPellet(pellet, base, dep[, linear[, blinding, digamma]])`, `registerRBMKRod(rod, base, dep[, blinding | linear])` -> `registerRBMK(rod, base, dep, hot, linear, blinding, digamma)`, `registerBreedingRodRadiation(BreedingRodType, base)`, `registerOtherFuel(fuel[, meta], base, target, blinding)`, `registerPWRFuel(EnumPWRFuel, baseRad)`, `registerRTGPellet(pellet, base, target[, hot[, blinding]])`, `registerOtherWaste(waste, base)`, `registerRadSourceWaste(waste, base)`, `makeData(type[, level[, override]])`. Generic entry: `HazardSystem.register(Object key, HazardData)`. The key is an `Item`, `Block`, `ItemStack` or `ComparableStack`, or an ore-dict `String`. Stack keys need size 1 and an exact meta: `ComparableStack.hashCode` includes both, so a `WILDCARD_VALUE` stack never matches (B-138); use the `Item` key for all metas. Other key types are silently ignored. Armor: `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmat(item, coefficient)` (piece weights helmet 0.2 / chest 0.4 / legs 0.3 / boots 0.1; `ArmorFSB.setRadResist` feeds the `external` list).
- `handler/EntityEffectHandler.onUpdate` (called from `ModEventHandler.onLivingUpdate` L816, on both sides) is the per-tick status driver for every living entity. Every 20 ticks it moves `radEnv` into `radBuf`. For every `EntityPlayerMP` it sends `ExtPropPacket` (HbmLivingProps + HbmPlayerProps) EVERY tick (L97-110, no tick guard). Server-only steps: bomb timer, 528 nether burn, crater-biome radiation, `handleOxy`/`handleCorrosion` (atmosphere via `getAtmosphereCached`). Then, in order: `handleContamination` (server; drains the timed `ContaminationEffect` list), `handleContagion`, `handleRadiationEffect` (server; mob transformations, potion tiers, death at >= 1000 RAD), `handleRadiationFX` (server: chunk radiation, nether floor, celestial sun, neutron-activation decay, vomit/hunger and sweat particles; client: radiation particles on players above 600 RAD), `handleDigamma` (particles only), `handleLungDisease`, `handleOil`, `handlePollution`, `handleTemperature`, `handleDashing`, `handlePlinking`, `handleFauxLadder` (players). A new per-entity status effect needs a `HbmLivingProps` field, persistence in `saveNBTData`/`loadNBTData`, `serialize`/`deserialize` in the same order if the client needs it, and a branch here.
- Hazard type gating is per type: `HAZ_*` kill-switches exist for asbestos, coal, hot, explosive, hydro, blinding (autism and glitch reuse it) and neutron. `HazardTypeRadiation`/`HazardTypeDigamma` have none. Radiation as a whole is switched by `RADIATION_00_enableContamination` (`RadiationConfig.enableContamination`): when off, `HbmLivingProps.getRadiation` returns 0 and `set/incrementRadiation` do nothing (L82-107). No source (items, chunks, sun, crater biomes) then builds a dose, though `ContaminationUtil.contaminate` still adds to `radEnv` (the Geiger reading). Digamma has no switch. `ArmorRegistry.hasProtection` is used only in the particle/light types; radiation/neutron gate armor inside `ContaminationUtil`.
- Ore-dict hazards: `DictFrame.rad(f)/hot(f)/neutron(f)/...` BEFORE the shape setters; each shape registers with its own multiplier; ingots also under the bare material name.
- Hazard ticks: `ModEventHandler.onPlayerTick` (server, START) -> `HazardSystem.updatePlayerInventory` every tick (nulls slots whose size hits 0). `ModEventHandler.onLivingUpdate` -> `updateLivingInventory` (server, non-players only, 5 equipment slots). `ModEventHandler.worldTick` (server, END) -> `updateDroppedItem` every `ServerConfig.ITEM_HAZARD_DROP_TICKRATE` ticks (default 2). Client tooltip (`ModEventHandlerClient` L802) -> `addFullTooltip`.
- Radiation emit: `ChunkRadiationManager.proxy.incrementRad(world, x, y, z, amount)`, server-side only (do not cache the proxy). `BlockHazard` uses scheduled ticks (`tickRate` 20, reschedules in `updateTick`), not `setTickRandomly`. Its amount (`rad` = item RADIATION level x 0.1) is an instance field on the Block singleton set only in `onBlockAdded`. After a server restart the saved scheduled ticks run with `rad == 0`, emit nothing and do not reschedule, so existing blocks go permanently silent; `BlockHazardFalling` has the same flaw, while `BlockSellafield` sets `rad` in its constructor and is unaffected. New emitters should compute the level in `updateTick` (or in the constructor).
- Pollution: two paths. (1) Machines extending `TileEntityMachinePolluting` call `pollute(PollutionType, amount)` or `pollute(FluidType, FluidReleaseType, amount)`. The amount x 100 goes into the smoke / smoke_leaded / smoke_poison tanks, and only tank overflow reaches `PollutionHandler.incrementPollution` (at /100F). `sendSmoke(x, y, z, dir)` pushes the tanks into chimneys; `TileEntityChimneyBase.transferFluid` (L100-104) then calls `incrementPollution` per smoke fluid at `fluid * getPollutionMod() / 100F`. (2) Direct emitters call `PollutionHandler.incrementPollution(world, x, y, z, PollutionType.SOOT, PollutionHandler.SOOT_PER_SECOND * n)` on a timer (e.g. `TileEntityMachineCoker` L112, `TileEntityFurnaceIron` L117).
- Atmosphere providers: implement `IAtmosphereProvider` (`getWorld`, `getMaxBlobRadius`, `getRootPosition`, `getFluidType`, `getFluidPressure`, `consume`, `produce`, `onBlobCreated`). Call `registerAtmosphere(this)` server-side once when supplying. Call `unregisterAtmosphere(this)` when it stops, in `invalidate()` AND in `onChunkUnload()` (calling `super.onChunkUnload()`); 1.7.10 does not invalidate TEs on chunk unload. `TileEntityAirPump` lacks the unload path, so its blob (keyed by TE identity) outlives the chunk and a reloaded pump adds a second one. Note register/unregister have no null guard for a missing dimension map (B-194). With `enableThreadedAtmospheres`, `onBlobCreated` runs on the pool thread.
- Sealable blocks implement `IBlockSealable` on the Block class: `AtmosphereBlob.isBlockSealed` (L87) tests the Block, so `TileEntityMachineHTRNeo` implementing it on the TE has no effect. When `isSealed` changes, call the default `updateSealedState(world, x, y, z)` server-side at the core position (it expands `BlockDummyable` dimensions). Only `TileEntityDoorGeneric` (L153/L157) does this. `BlockDoorGeneric` seals while closed; `BlockOrbitalStation` always seals. `MachineFan`, `BlockAirPump`, `MachineDiesel`, `MachineBrickFurnace`, `MachineDiFurnace` and `BlockFurnaceSpace` always return false. That keeps their own block position inside blobs so `TileEntityMachineBase.breatheAir` (L222-239), the fan's `getAtmosphere` (MachineFan L100) and the air pump's root position (its own coordinates) find the pressurised air. A new full-cube, single-block machine that breathes needs the same (`BlockDummyable` machines are open anyway).
- Per-world state: radiation (`ChunkRadiationHandlerSimple.perWorld` HashMap, PRISM `ConcurrentHashMap`) and pollution (`PollutionHandler.perWorld`, only when `enablePollution`) are keyed by `World`, filled on `WorldEvent.Load` and removed on `WorldEvent.Unload`, both behind `!isRemote`. The neutron nodespace (`NeutronNodeWorld.streamWorlds`, `HashMap<World, StreamWorld>`) is created lazily by `getOrAddWorld(world)` (NeutronStream, RBMK and pile TEs). Empty `StreamWorld`s are dropped every server tick by `NeutronHandler.onServerTick`, and `ModEventHandler.onUnload` (L835-836, no side guard) removes the world on `WorldEvent.Unload`. Atmosphere (`worldBlobs`, `growthMap`) is keyed by dimension id and filled on `WorldEvent.Load` (`!isRemote`). Nuke-shock (`CelestialNukeShockHandler.serverStatuses`) is keyed by the target body's dimension id and filled by `trigger()`, which runs on `EntityJoinWorldEvent` of a fresh `EntityNukeExplosionMK5` and from `ExplosionNukeSmall.explode` (mini-nuke params). It is cleared per dimension on `WorldEvent.Unload`.
- WorldSavedData: public `(String)` constructor (vanilla `MapStorage.loadData` uses `Class.getConstructor(String.class)` and throws a RuntimeException otherwise). `forWorld(world)` = `perWorldStorage.loadData`, else `setData` + reload. Call `markDirty()` after mutation. Client sync is not automatic: it is written by hand per type in `PermaSyncHandler` (today only Tom impact data, `SolarSystemWorldSavedData` traits and satellites; `AnnihilatorSavedData` is not synced).
- Compat gating: `Loader.isModLoaded`/`Compat.isModLoaded` in static `init()` from `MainRegistry.PostLoad`; `@Optional` on foreign-API members; `Compat.tryLoadItem(modid, name)` returns null when absent.

### How-to

- Item hazard: `HazardSystem.register(ModItems.x, makeData(RADIATION, pu239 * ingot))` in `HazardRegistry.registerItems()` (outside that class build `new HazardData().addEntry(type, level[, override])`); depletion-scaled: `new HazardEntry(RADIATION, base).addMod(new HazardModifierFuelRadiation(target))`. `register` is a plain map put (`HazardSystem` L54-66), so the later call wins for the same key: the `DBSFork.init()` hook (`MainRegistry` L285) runs before `HazardRegistry.registerItems()` (L296), so upstream data for the same key replaces a hook registration.
- New hazard type: `type/HazardTypeX extends HazardTypeBase`. Implement `onUpdate(target, level, stack)`: it runs every tick per carried stack and the level is per item, so multiply by `stack.stackSize`. Gate it on a new `RadiationConfig.disableX` created in `RadiationConfig.loadFromConfig` under a new `HAZ_xx_` key, plus optionally `ArmorRegistry.hasProtection(target, 3, HazardClass.X)`. Implement `updateEntity(item, level)` for dropped items, which runs every `ServerConfig.ITEM_HAZARD_DROP_TICKRATE` ticks (default 2), and `addHazardInformation(...)` (client) using a new `trait.x` key in `en_US.lang`. Add the singleton in `HazardRegistry` and an optional `DictFrame.x(float)` helper in `OreDictManager.DictFrame`. Exemplar `HazardTypeCoal.java`.
- Material hazards: `.rad(HazardRegistry.x)` before the shape calls on the material's `DictFrame` line in `OreDictManager`.
- Modifier/transformer: extend `HazardModifier` (`modify(stack, holder, level)`; `holder` is null for dropped items and in `getHazardLevelFromStack`) or `HazardTransformerBase`. A transformer implements both abstract `transformPre` and `transformPost` and is registered in `registerTrafos()`. `HazardTransformerRadiationNBT` already appends a RADIATION entry (possibly level 0) to every stack. Beware recursion through `getHazardLevelFromStack` for container items. Exemplars `HazardModifierRTGRadiation.java`, `HazardTransformerRadiationME.java`.
- Radiation backend: extend `ChunkRadiationHandler` (6 abstract + `receive*` hooks; unload by `ChunkCoordIntPair`), select it after the PRISM line in `RadiationConfig.loadFromConfig`. Exemplar `ChunkRadiationHandlerSimple.java`.
- Neutron system: see `handler/neutron/package-info.java`; new `NeutronType`, `MyNeutronHandler` with node/`makeNode`/stream classes; TE creates streams on server tick and removes its node in `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload` (`TileEntityPileBase` exemplar is @Deprecated).
- Atmosphere provider / sealable block: provider exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityAirPump.java` (register L98, unregister L148/L184; also add an `onChunkUnload` unregister, which it lacks). State-changing sealable exemplar: `BlockDoorGeneric.isSealed` (L197) plus `TileEntityDoorGeneric` (`updateSealedState` at L153/L157). `MachineFan.isSealed` always returns false; it only keeps its own position inside blobs.
- Satellite: `SatelliteX extends SatelliteBase` with a public no-arg constructor (`createFromId`/`createFromItem` use `newInstance()` and swallow failures, which then NPEs in `SatelliteSavedData.readFromNBT`). Implement `getType`, the NBT chain (`super.writeToNBT/readFromNBT`), `serialize`/`deserialize` in the same order for client-visible fields (`PermaSyncHandler` syncs satellites via `getID()` + `serialize`), and `CMD_*` in `onCommandImpl`. Add `registerSatellite(SatelliteX.class, ModItems.sat_x, r, g, b)` at the END of `XSatelliteRegistry.register()` (default marker colour; 0,0,0 is invisible, B-209). Add a `getTargetDimensionId` branch if body-specific, `SatelliteMiner.registerCargo(SatelliteX.class, ItemPoolsSatellite.POOL_...)` for miners, and call `markDirty()` after mutating `sats`. Exemplar `SatelliteDeathRay.java`.
- Bobmazon offer: `standard.add(new Offer(stack, Requirement.X, cost))` in `init()` (idempotent, cleared each world load).
- Hazmat rating: `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmat(item, coefficient * helmet)` in `initDefault()`; ArmorFSB pieces push via `setRadResist`; other mods via `Compat.registerCompatHazmat`; user `hbmRadResist.json` replaces the whole map.
- AE2 storage: `IMEInventory<IAEItemStack>` + `IExternalStorageHandler` registered in `AE2CompatHandler.registerHandler()`. Exemplar `MSUExternalStorageHandler.java`. Keep implementing the StorageChannel variants: GTNH AE2 rv3-beta-1071 (the owner's pack) made `IMEInventory.getAvailableItems(IItemList)` and `getChannel()` defaults that delegate both ways to new overloads (`getAvailableItems(IItemList, int)`, `getStackType()`), and gave `IExternalStorageHandler` `IAEStackType` overloads of `canHandle`/`getInventory` that delegate both ways to the StorageChannel ones. The current handlers reach fork code on every path, but a handler implementing neither half of such a pair recurses into a `StackOverflowError`.
- Saved data: `MySaveData extends WorldSavedData` with `KEY`, `(String)` ctor, `forWorld`. Exemplar `TomSaveData.java`.
- Microblocks: `registerMicroBlockCompat(ModBlocks.x)` in `MicroBlocksCompatHandler.preInit()`.

### Gotchas

- `RadiationConfig.disableNeutron` defaults true (whole neutron-activation path off; key shares the `HAZ_01` prefix with `disableCoaldust`). With neutrons enabled, `HazardTypeNeutron.onUpdate` applies armor twice: `calculateRadiationMod` at L39, then again inside `ContaminationUtil.contaminate(NEUTRON, CREATIVE)` (L296). The owner's `hbm.cfg` sets `HAZ_01_disableNeutrons=false`, so the neutron path is live there.
- Owner's pack: `hbm.cfg` runs the Simple backend (`RADIATION_99_enablePRISM=false`, chunk radiation and `RADWORLD_00_toggle` on), so the Simple-backend defects are live there and the PRISM-only ones are not. EndlessIDs 1.7.4 still mixes `ChunkRadiationHandlerPRISM` at every startup (the class is loaded because `RadiationConfig.java:60` references it): a required mixin config puts `require = 1` `@Redirect`s on `ExtendedBlockStorage.getBlockLSBArray()` in `updateSystem` (L179, call at L222) and in `SubChunk.rebuild` (L361, call at L391; applied only when `SubChunk` loads, i.e. with PRISM on). Renaming `updateSystem` or removing its `getBlockLSBArray()` call crashes the pack at launch whatever the PRISM setting, and the same change in `rebuild` crashes once PRISM runs. EndlessIDs also makes the vanilla `getBlockLSBArray`/`getBlockMSBArray`/`getMetadataArray` accessors (and their setters) throw, so new code reads blocks through `getBlockByExtId`/`getExtBlockMetadata`.
- Owner's pack: `HazardTransformerRadiationME` (L20-21) matches only the exact class names `appeng.items.storage.ItemBasicStorageCell` and `appeng.items.tools.powered.ToolPortableCell`. GTNH AE2 rv3-beta-1071 builds its 256k-16384k cells as `ItemAdvancedStorageCell` and the container/quantum/singularity/universe cells as `ItemExtremeStorageCell` (both subclasses of `ItemBasicStorageCell`), so radioactive items stored in those cells carry no hazard. `Compat.scrapeItemFromME` also reads AE2's long `@<i>` counts with `getInteger` (L145), which truncates counts of 2^31 and more.
- `HazardData.doesOverride` is a single flag rewritten by every `addEntry(type)`, `addEntry(type, level)` and `addEntry(type, level, override)` call (the short forms pass `false`), so the LAST such call decides it. `makeData(RADIATION, x, true).addEntry(HOT, 5)` loses the override, while `addEntry(HazardEntry)` leaves the flag alone. Oredict mutex means only the FIRST matching oredict key counts (all autogen ore data uses bit `0b1`). Item- and stack-keyed data have mutex 0 and always stack on top of ore data unless they override.
- `HazardRegistry.registerItems` runs before `OreDictManager.registerOres`; lookup is lazy so this works.
- `AtmosphereBlob.isBlockSealed`: a `BlockDummyable` never seals unless it is `IBlockSealable` (checked first). Air, farmland, fences, liquids, non-solid materials and leaves never seal. Every other block is classified ONCE PER Block (not per meta or position) from `getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool(null, x, y, z)` and cached forever in the static `fullBounds` map. Blocks whose collision box reads the world (walls, fence gates, trapdoors) throw on the null world and are cached as leaking. Blocks using vanilla's default box report the shared instance's current bounds: single slabs leak, stairs normally seal (their collision code resets bounds to a full cube), and panes depend on the last neighbour-based bounds, so results can differ between runs. `ThreeInts` is mutable and used as a HashMap key in `AtmosphereBlob.plants`.
- `ChunkAtmosphereHandler.getAtmosphere` returns null both for vacuum and for "no data" (client worlds, dimensions before `WorldEvent.Load`; L73-74, L91), and callers treat null as vacuum. Machine breathing (`TileEntityMachineBase.breatheAir` L225/L232) accepts EARTHAIR >= 0.19, while `canBreathe` needs >= 0.21 (L177).
- `XSatelliteRegistry` ids: never insert in the middle; duplicate class/item registrations silently ignored. Ids come from `currentId++` in call order, and the `DBSFork.init()` hook (`MainRegistry` L285) runs before `XSatelliteRegistry.register()` (L292), so a satellite registered from the hook would take id 0 and shift every saved id; register it at the end of `register()` or after L292. `SatelliteSavedData.readFromNBT` NPEs on unknown ids. `SatelliteSavedData.getData(world, x, z)` from orbit and `XSatelliteRegistry.orbit` call `DimensionManager.initDimension` for an unloaded target body (L88-91, L87-90), so both load another dimension.
- `HTTPHandler`'s version check compares `DBSVersion.REVISION` with the fork's branch (B-008 fixed, area 1); `MicroBlocksCompatHandler` skips meta 15; `HazmatRegistry` piece weights 0.2/0.4/0.3/0.1.
- `ContaminationUtil.contaminate` relies on deprecated `ArmorUtil.checkForHazmat/Haz2`; its javadoc recommends `ArmorRegistry` + `HbmLivingProps` for new hazards.
- Per-player packets every tick: `ExtPropPacket` (`EntityEffectHandler` L97-110) and `PermaSyncPacket` (`ModEventHandler.onPlayerTick` L1481). PermaSync carries the satellites of the player's body plus every loaded landable body (`PermaSyncHandler` L118-142), so keep satellite `serialize` small.
- Smells: `NeutronNodeWorld.java:75` stale TODO about uncaching pile nodes (not a leak: `TileEntityPileBase` removes its node in `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload`, L20-28); `ChunkAtmosphereHandler.java:215` TODO CO2; `SatelliteRailgun.java:93` TODO projectile types (`new Random()` per shot); `OreDictManager` ~L1040 TODO hazard shapes; dead `ChunkRadiationHandlerNT`/`3D`/`Blank`, `HbmMaterials`, `Identity.value`, `BlockMigrations.doMigraion`; `PollutionHandler.decorateMob` heals mobs on every spawn event subtype; `AnnihilatorSavedData` swallows Throwable; because `HazardTransformerRadiationNBT` gives every stack a RADIATION entry and `HazardSystem.applyHazards` (L185-189) has no level check, `HazardTypeRadiation.onUpdate` runs for every carried stack each tick and scans the inventory for the reacher (L29-30) before its `level > 0` check (L38).

## 14. Dimensions and world generation (NTM: Space)

### Purpose

`com/hbm/dim/` (159 Java files, all Space-added) defines the KSP-derived solar system (`SolarSystem`/`CelestialBody` builder tree, orbital mechanics, delta-V), replaces the overworld provider with `WorldProviderEarth`, and adds dimensions Mun, Duna, Ike, Eve, Dres, Moho, Minmus, Laythe, Tekto, Thatmo and Orbit. Each body is a package with `WorldProvider<Body> extends WorldProviderCelestial`, `ChunkProvider<Body> extends ChunkProviderCelestial`, `BiomeGen*<Body> extends BiomeGenBaseCelestial`, optional `genlayer/`, and `WorldGenerator<Body> implements IWorldGenerator`. Per-body traits (`CBT_*`) persist in `SolarSystemWorldSavedData` and sync via `PermaSyncHandler`. `com/hbm/world/` holds feature generators (`OreLayer3D`, `OreCave`, `BedrockOre`, `SchistStratum`, `DepthDeposit`, `Meteorite`), the NBT/jigsaw structure system with LogicBlock scripting, legacy generators and `MapGenChainloader`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `dim/SolarSystem.java`, `CelestialBody.java` | Body tree (`init()` chained builders), `Body` enum (ordinal = ore meta, max 16; `getBody()` falls back to Kerbin for name mismatches), sky metrics, delta-V (`getCostBetween`, `calculateHohmannTransfer`); body data + builder (`withMassRadius`, `withOrbitalParameters`, `withTraits`, `withSatellites`, `withBlockTextures` (mandatory: `BlockOre.registerBlockIcons` dereferences `getStoneTexture()` for every non-ORBIT Body)), lookups (`getBody(int / String / World)` fall back to dim 0; `getBodyOrNull`), trait API (`getTraits` returns the LIVE saved map when overrides exist, not a clone; `setTraits` replaces the whole set; use `modifyTraits`), `getGravity`, `inOrbit`, `getMeta`. |

Planets never post `PopulateChunkEvent.Pre` and rely on the `generate()` fallback, which is gated by a single global `hasPopulationEvent` flag set by any Pre event (overworld, Nether, End) and reset only on `WorldEvent.Load`; see known-bugs B-227), vanilla cave-gen chainloader (dims 0/-1), bubble/oil carvers, structure statics, world-gen registration, legacy generator (meteorite/spaceship rolls on all celestial dims, ores/dungeons overworld only). |

### Patterns

- Body registration is a builder tree; `CelestialBody(String, int dimId, Body type)` registers `dimToBodyMap` and `canLand`.
- Per-body package convention: `WorldProvider<Body>` (`registerWorldChunkManager`, `getDimensionName`, `createChunkGenerator`, `getStone`), `ChunkProvider<Body>`, `BiomeGen<Body>` (static final instances from `SpaceConfig` IDs; `genTerrainBlocks` compares against the planet stone), `WorldGenerator<Body>` (registers structures/ore visibility in the ctor, ores in `generate`).
- Single-biome bodies: `WorldChunkManagerHell(biome, 0.0F)`; multi-biome: `createBiomeGenerators(seed)` GenLayer chain -> `WorldChunkManagerCelestial(new BiomeGenLayers(biomeLayer, detailLayer, seed))`.
- Ores: `DungeonToolbox.generateOre(world, rand, x, z, veinCount, amount, minY, variance, ore, CelestialBody.getMeta(world), provider.getStone())`; visibility `BlockOre.addValidBody(ore, Body.X)`.
- Config keys: `17.NN_` dims, `16.NN_` biomes, `1.9x_` space general, `2.xx` ores/oil, `5.xx` structures; dimension IDs count up from 413_015, biome IDs down from 126. The space biomes (`SpaceConfig.java:125`) and the crater biomes 80-82 (`17.B00-B02`, `WorldConfig.java:175-177`, offset at L352) both default 12000 higher when EndlessIDs is loaded; the owner's `hbm.cfg` holds 12080-12082 and 12087-12126 (the offset only changes defaults for missing keys).
- Structures: `.nbt` under `assets/hbm/structures/<group>/`, static in `StructureManager`, `NBTStructure.registerStructure(dimId, new SpawnCondition("name") {{ structure = new JigsawPiece("name", StructureManager.x, heightOffset); canSpawn = biome -> ...; spawnWeight = n; }})` in an IWorldGenerator ctor; jigsaw via `pools`/`startPool`/`sizeLimit`/`fallback`; `registerNullWeight` competes in the same roll; one candidate per `structureMaxChunks` grid cell.
- Traits: defaults via `withTraits`; runtime via `CelestialBody.modifyTraits(world, trait)`; read via `getTrait(world, CBT_X.class)`; client copies in `SolarSystemWorldSavedData.clientTraits`; `update(isRemote, body)` runs every tick on both sides.
- Vacuum handling: `isHellWorld` trick on low-pressure bodies; `ModEventHandler.onBucketUse` handles pressurised rooms; `updateWaterOpacity` mutates `Blocks.water` opacity globally every world tick (flickers between dims).

### How-to

- New landable body: `SpaceConfig` dim + biome ids; append `FOO("foo")` to `SolarSystem.Body` (ore meta, max 16 entries) and `new CelestialBody("foo", SpaceConfig.fooDimension, Body.FOO).withMassRadius(...).withOrbitalParameters(...).withRotationalPeriod(...).withColor(...).withBlockTextures(...)` (+ traits) inside the parent's `withSatellites`; textures `textures/misc/space/foo.png` and `textures/items/votv.foo.png` (VOTV drive overlay, registered for every Body); lang `body.foo` (en_US + mirrors; used by ore tooltips, rocket/station GUIs, NEI, Stardar, bedrock ore); package `dim/foo/` (BiomeGenFoo, usually with `BiomeDecoratorCelestial(stone)`; ChunkProviderFoo; WorldProviderFoo; WorldGeneratorFoo whose `generate` must return unless `world.provider.dimensionId == SpaceConfig.fooDimension`, because every IWorldGenerator runs in every dimension); `PlanetGen.init()`: `registerDimension(...)` above the `WorldGeneratorCelestial` line and `GameRegistry.registerWorldGenerator(new WorldGeneratorFoo(), 1)`; `ItemBedrockOreNew.CelestialBedrockOre` `register(Body.FOO, ...)` (mandatory: `BedrockOre.generateAuto` NPEs without it); optional `OreCave`/`OreLayer3D` in PostLoad, `ModBiomes` tags, `WorldConfig` knobs. Exemplar `dim/moon/WorldProviderMoon.java`.
- Multi-biome body: `BiomeGenBase<Body>` with static instances + `BiomeDecoratorCelestial(stone)`; root `GenLayer<Body>Biomes`, shaping layers, `createBiomeGenerators`; biome-dependent carving pre/post `replaceBlocksForBiome` (`ChunkProviderDuna`). Exemplar `dim/duna/WorldProviderDuna.java`.
- Ore vein: in the body's `WorldGenerator<Body>.generate` add `DungeonToolbox.generateOre(world, rand, x, z, veins, amount, minY, variance, ModBlocks.ore_x, CelestialBody.getMeta(world), provider.getStone())`, `BlockOre.addValidBody(ModBlocks.ore_x, Body.X)` in the ctor, a `WorldConfig` knob for counts. The meta argument is the block metadata: `CelestialBody.getMeta(world)` fits only planet-meta blocks (`BlockOre`, `BlockOreFluid`); other blocks pass their own meta (`WorldGeneratorCelestial` L229 `EnumStoneType.CALCIUM.ordinal()` for `stone_resource`, L194 `0` for `ore_alexandrite`). Exemplars `dim/moon/WorldGeneratorMoon.java`, `dim/duna/WorldGeneratorDuna.java`.
- Jigsaw / NBT structure: `StructureManager` static; `NBTStructure.registerStructure(dimId, new SpawnCondition("name") {{ structure = new JigsawPiece(...); pools = ...; startPool = "..."; sizeLimit = 8; minHeight/maxHeight; canSpawn = biome -> ...; spawnWeight = n; }})` in the generator ctor (or `registerStructure(spawn, int[] dimensionIds)`, as the meteor dungeon does with `PlanetGen.getSpaceDimensions()`); per-piece options `instanceLimit` (max copies per structure), `required` (must be placed), `blockTable` (`Map<Block, BlockSelector>` random substitution), `platform`, `alignToTerrain`/`conformToTerrain`, `heightOffset`; SpawnCondition extras `rangeLimit` (<= 128), `start` (non-NBT StructureStart factory), `checkCoordinates` (fixed-placement predicate: goes to `customSpawnMap`, is tested before the grid roll, bypasses biome and weight, and works only with `pools`/`structure`). Test placement with `/ntmlocate structure <name>` (`/ntmlocate list` for names; it replays the grid and biome roll through `HbmWorld.worldGenerator.getStructureAt` without generating anything, `CommandLocate.java:82-101`); `SpawnCondition.buildAll(world, x, y, z)` builds every pool piece in rows but has no caller, no-ops unless `ServerConfig.STRUCTURE_DEBUG`, and NPEs without `pools`, so call it from a debug command or item. Exemplars `dim/WorldGeneratorCelestial.java` (meteor dungeon pools), overworld `world/gen/NTMWorldGenerator.java` (+ `StructureConfig` weight).
- Trait: `CBT_Foo extends CelestialBodyTrait` with a public no-arg ctor (`newInstance()` in `SolarSystemWorldSavedData.readFromNBT` and `PermaSyncHandler`), `readFromNBT`/`writeToNBT` (persistence, keyed by the registered name) and `readFromBytes`/`writeToBytes` (client sync, keyed by the `traitList` index); optional `update(isRemote, body)`. Append `registerTrait("foo", CBT_Foo.class)` at the END of the static block; read with `CelestialBody.getTrait(world, CBT_Foo.class)`. Exemplar `dim/trait/CBT_Temperature.java`.
- Carver: `MapGen*` subclass (extend `MapGenBase`/`MapGenCaves` for pure carving) called directly from `ChunkProvider<Body>.getChunkPrimer` via `func_151539_a(this, worldObj, x, z, buffer.blocks)`. Only a carver that places planet-meta blocks (ores, fluid ores) needs meta handling: extend `com.hbm.world.gen.MapGenBaseMeta`, add a `byte meta` field as `MapGenBubble`/`MapGenBedrockOil` do, set `meta = (byte) CelestialBody.getMeta(world)` (or `Body.X.ordinal()`) in the ChunkProvider ctor and call `setMetas(buffer.metas)` before each `func_151539_a` (`ChunkProviderTekto` L35-61, `ChunkProviderEve` L42-59). Exemplar `dim/moon/ChunkProviderMoon.java`.
- Weather / sky / fog per body: override on `WorldProvider<Body>` the `WorldProviderCelestial` hooks `updateWeather`, `fogDensity(FogDensity)` (fog thickness), `getFogColor(solarAngle, y)`, `getSkyColor(camera, partialTicks)`, `getStarBrightness`, `getSunBrightness`, `getSunColor`, `updateLightmap`, `getHorizon`, `getCloudHeight`, `getSkyRenderer`/`getCloudRenderer`/`getWeatherRenderer`, `calculateCelestialAngle`, `resetRainAndThunder`, `hasIce`, `hasLife` (false by default, true only on Earth and Laythe; when false, `ModEventHandler.preventOrganicSpawn` DENYs the organic Decorate events (TREE, GRASS, FLOWERS, REED, SHROOM, ...), which also switches off `BiomeDecoratorCelestial`'s REED-gated `waterPlantsPerChunk`/`rubberPlantsPerChunk`/`coralPerChunk`, so Tekto's rubber plants never generate; it does not affect mob spawning, which follows the biome spawn lists), `getWaterOpacity`, `getStone`, `getBedrockAcid` (plus vanilla `isDaytime`); persist per-body state in `writeToNBT`/`readFromNBT` (stored through `CelestialBodyWorldSavedData`) and sync it in `serialize`/`deserialize` (PermaSyncHandler, non-overworld only), calling `super` first in each (the base serialize/deserialize carry the world time); decorator knobs in `BiomeDecoratorCelestial` (`lakeBlock`, `lakeChancePerChunk`, `lavaCount`, `coralPerChunk`, `waterPlantsPerChunk`, `rubberPlantsPerChunk`, `seaLevel`). Exemplar `dim/duna/WorldProviderDuna.java` (dust storms).
- LogicBlock action: `actions.put("FOO", FOO)` in `world/gen/util/LogicBlockActions.initialize()`.

### Gotchas

- `Body.ordinal()` is persisted ore metadata: never reorder; max 16 entries (11 used).
- `OreLayer3D`/`OreCave` fire only for decorators that post `DecorateBiomeEvent.Pre`.
- `NBTStructure.validBiomeCache` (private static, per dimension and biome id, filled lazily by `GenStructure.findSpawn`) is never invalidated: a structure registered after a dimension/biome entry is cached is never rolled there; register structures before world load.
- Seventeen celestial biomes (Duna Plains/Polar/PolarHills, Dres Plains/Canyon, all five Eve biomes, all five Tekto biomes, Laythe Polar, Thatmo) use `Math.random()` in `genTerrainBlocks` (non-deterministic terrain).
- `StructureConfig.structureMaxChunks` field default 12 vs config default 16; `setDef` only replaces non-positive values and min > max resets both to 8/24, but min == max is not caught: `NBTStructure.GenStructure.getSpawnAtCoords` then calls `rand.nextInt(0)` and structure generation crashes ('Exception preparing structure feature'). Settled: B-391 (Phase 6, with B-229) changes the `StructureConfig` check to `>=`.
- `BiomeGenNoMansLand`/`WorldProviderTom`/`BiomeDecoratorNoMansLand` are dead; `BiomeGenNoMansLand` hard-codes id 99 (= default `mohoLavaBiome`).
- Eve's `WorldGenElectricVolcano`/`WorldGenEveSpike` cascade chunks (TODO at `WorldGeneratorEve.java:60`); `WorldGeneratorIke` scans every column for `ModBlocks.pedestal` each chunk.
- Owner's pack: hodgepodge throttles cascading population, deferring nested chunk population to a scheduler instead of running it recursively. Cascades such as Eve's (B-239) are therefore masked there and neighbour population order (and so decoration seed parity) differs from vanilla; reproduce with hodgepodge `throttleChunkGeneration=false` before treating a cascade fix as confirmed. The planets' missing `PopulateChunkEvent` (B-233) is unaffected.
- EndlessIDs detection keys on the mod being present (`Loader.isModLoaded(Compat.MOD_EIDS)` at `SpaceConfig.java:125`, `WorldConfig.java:352` and the `WorldUtil` static initialiser, `world/WorldUtil.java:29-37`), not on its `extendBiome` flag. With EndlessIDs installed and `extendBiome=false`, `WorldUtil` fails to initialise (the `getBiomeShortArray` lookup throws a message-less `AssertionError`), so `ChunkProviderCelestial`/`ChunkProviderOrbit.provideChunk` and fallout biome changes throw `NoClassDefFoundError`, and fresh biome defaults exceed the 256-entry list. Latent: the owner's pack has `extendBiome=true`. EndlessIDs makes `Chunk.getBiomeArray()`/`setBiomeArray()` throw; every fork call sits in the non-EndlessIDs branch (`WorldUtil` L49/59/69/89, `BiomeSyncPacket.java:118`, `ChunkProviderCelestial.java:356`, `ChunkProviderOrbit.java:44`), so route new biome reads and writes through `WorldUtil`.
- Owner's pack: Angelica 2.2.20 (`angelica-compat.cfg` `fixNTMSpace=true`) mixes `MixinSkyProviderCelestial`, `MixinSkyProviderOrbit` and `MixinSkyProviderLaytheSunset` into `SkyProviderCelestial.render`, `renderSun` (L710, a `WrapOperation` target), `renderSunset`, `renderCelestials` and `renderAtmosphereGlow`, `SkyProviderOrbit.render` and `SkyProviderLaytheSunset.renderSunset`, with injection points chosen by call order (`glDisable`, `glCallList` ordinals 1/2, `glRotatef` ordinal 2, `Tessellator.draw` slices). The config sets no `defaultRequire`, so adding or removing such a GL call before those ordinals, or changing `renderSun`'s signature, silently moves or drops Angelica's shader-pass fixes (under shaders the horizon, void or sun is drawn in the wrong program, with no log error). Keep the call order and the signature, or re-test the sky with an Iris shader pack.
- `SpaceConfig` duplicate prefixes `17.10_` (tekto/thatmo), `16.24_` (eveRiver/laytheCoast) and `1.93_` (maxStationDistance/showOreLocations); `WorldGeneratorDres` registers `ore_lanthanium` twice; `ModBiomes.init()` registers `dunaHills` twice (L16-17, the second evidently meant for `dunaPolarHills`: `dunaHills` gets SNOWY/MOUNTAIN on top of HILLS, and `dunaPolarHills` keeps only the COLD/DRY/DEAD that every Duna biome registers in the `BiomeGenBaseDuna` ctor, L31).
- Biome classes initialise lazily: only Duna and Minmus are touched during mod loading (`ModBiomes.init()`, `MainRegistry` L286); every other body's biome statics, with their `checkId` collision guard (`BiomeGenBaseCelestial` L18-33) and ctor-time `BiomeDictionary.registerBiomeType` (`BiomeGenBaseTekto` L34, `BiomeGenBaseEve` L30, `BiomeGenBaseLaythe` L48), are built when the body's provider, chunk provider or generator first touches the class (generators only inside `generate` or `canSpawn` lambdas, e.g. `WorldGeneratorTekto` L60, `WorldGeneratorLaythe` L29); the server creates every registered dimension's provider and chunk provider when a world starts (`MinecraftServer.loadAllWorlds` over `DimensionManager.getStaticDimensionIDs()`), so most of these are built at world start, after all mod init phases, not during mod loading; touch the biome class in PreLoad if a new body's biomes or dictionary tags must exist earlier.
- Smells: `SkyProviderCelestial.java:279` TODO fix EVERYTHING; `SkyProviderThatmo.java:65` @Spaghetti; `WorldGeneratorIke.java:67` "HACKIEST hack"; `NBTStructure.java:87` @Untested; `TimedGenerator` @Deprecated/@Spaghetti yet ticked from `worldTick`; `CellularDungeon*`/`JungleDungeon` @Deprecated but generated; `ChunkProviderTekto.java:28` `reclamp = false` comment; `world/test/*` unreferenced scaffolding.

### Open questions

- Is Thatmo intentionally unbound (WIP) or a regression? Binding needs a `Body.THATMO` entry (append; `//THATMO` is commented at `SolarSystem.java` L321), the `(name, id, Body)` ctor plus `withBlockTextures(...)` (mandatory: `BlockOre.registerBlockIcons` NPEs otherwise), `GameRegistry.registerWorldGenerator(new WorldGeneratorThatmo(), 1)`, and uncommenting the bedrock table at `ItemBedrockOreNew` L284-294 (dimension registration, lang `body.thatmo` and `votv.thatmo.png` already exist); binding also makes `WorldProviderThatmo` see its own `CBT_BATTLEFIELD` trait instead of Kerbin's. Today Thatmo is already a registered space dimension (`PlanetGen.java:47`), so the meteor dungeon, `WorldGeneratorCelestial` ores and bedrock ores run there with Kerbin's meta and Kerbin's bedrock table.
- Whether `OreLayer3D`'s z-axis bug should be fixed (changes existing strata); whether unused `GenLayerDunaHills`/`PolarHills` are intentional; `CBT_COMPROMISED` (inner, registered as `infected`) vs the empty top-level `CBT_Compromised`.
- Have NBT structures from one dimension turned up in another (Mun base or meteor dungeon pieces in the overworld), or have planets stopped getting structures after overworld exploration in the same session? The answer sets the priority of the shared-`nbtGen`/`hasPopulationEvent` fix (B-227, paired with B-233).
- Should Tekto have natural rubber plants? Its biomes request 64 per chunk (`BiomeGenBaseTekto.java:28`), but the no-life decoration filter blocks them: `WorldProviderTekto.hasLife()` returning true (also re-enables tree/grass events there) or planet-specific plants off the vanilla REED event.

## 15. Client rendering, models, animations, particles, sound

### Purpose

`main/ResourceManager` (1868 lines, no `@SideOnly`; static init needs a GL context) registers OBJ models (`HFRWavefrontObject`, mostly `.asVBO()`), textures, 6 JSON gun animations and 1 Collada door animation. `ClientProxy` is the registration hub: 278 TESRs, 155 entity renderers, 60 ISBRH registrations (59 legacy handlers plus `RenderISBRHUniversal`), ~90 explicit `IItemRenderer`s (plus 68 gun renderers in `GunFactoryClient`) and automatic ones for every `IItemRendererProvider`, the client event handlers, reload listeners (`HFRModelReloader` rebuilds OBJ/VBO on F3+T, `QMAWLoader`), and the 67-branch `effectNT` particle dispatcher. Two animation systems: the "bus" keyframes (`render/anim`, sedna guns and SEDNA doors; most guns build them in Java, 6 guns load Blender JSON) and Drillgon's Collada `animloader` (seal door only). Particles are vanilla `EntityFX` subclasses spawned from `AuxParticlePacketNT` NBT; sound loops are `AudioWrapper`/`AudioDynamic` keyed by `NTMSounds` ids from `sounds.json`.

### Patterns

- Proxy lifecycle (`MainRegistry.PreLoad`): `registerPreRenderInfo` (L282), then `ModBlocks`/`ModItems`. Inside `ModItems.mainRegistry()`, `GunFactory.init()` (ModItems L4881) calls `proxy.registerGunCfg()` (GunFactory L93) -> `GunFactoryClient.init()`, which registers 68 gun item renderers; `ResourceManager`'s static init runs here at the latest (GunFactoryClient L47), so a bad OBJ surfaces as an error during ModItems init. Then `DBSFork.init()` and `ModBiomes.init()`, then `registerRenderInfo` (L287): client event handlers -> TESRs -> item renderers (`ItemRenderLibrary`, then the `IItemRendererProvider` scans of TESRs and items, then the explicit ones) -> entity renderers -> block renderers (item auto-registration depends on TESRs already bound). Missile-part renderers come in `PostLoad` via `registerMissileItems` (L612). For the same Item the last `registerItemRenderer` call wins (Forge keeps one renderer per Item).
- Models: `public static final IModelCustom x = new HFRWavefrontObject(new ResourceLocation(RefStrings.MODID, "models/<cat>/<name>.obj")).asVBO();` + `x_tex` ResourceLocation; renderers `bindTexture(ResourceManager.x_tex); ResourceManager.x.renderPart("Group")`. Group names are the API: `HFRWavefrontObject` and the VBO match them case-insensitively, `ObjUtil.renderPartWithIcon` case-sensitively; renaming a group in Blender silently stops the part drawing. `g`/`o` names must be one token of `[A-Za-z0-9_.]` (HFRWavefrontObject L41), vertex values plain decimals with no exponent (L34), faces 3 or 4 vertices (L37-40); anything else throws `ModelFormatException` in `ResourceManager`'s static init and crashes the client. `.noSmooth()` affects only Tessellator rendering of the non-VBO object (`S_Face`); a VBO always uses the file's vertex normals (HFRWavefrontObjectVBO L43-56), so the 30 `.noSmooth().asVBO()` fields get nothing from it. For flat shading export flat normals from Blender.
- TESR: `extends TileEntitySpecialRenderer implements IItemRendererProvider`; `glPushMatrix`, `glTranslated(x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5)`, `glEnable(GL_LIGHTING)`, `switch(tile.getBlockMetadata() - BlockDummyable.offset)` cases 2..5 (mapping varies per renderer), bind, render parts with `last + (cur - last) * interp`, restore GL state, `glPopMatrix`; bound with `ClientRegistry.bindTileEntitySpecialRenderer` in `ClientProxy`.
- ISBRH: new blocks implement `ISBRHUniversal`; legacy per-block `renderID` + handler registration is discouraged; VBO models cannot be tessellated (ISBRH needs the non-VBO copies in the `//ISBRHs` section; RBMK models are loaded twice for this reason).
- Bus animation playback: server `HbmAnimationPacket` -> `HbmAnimations.hotbar[slot][index]`; renderers read `HbmAnimations.getRelevantTransformation("Bus")` (51 sedna gun renderers), and the 6 JSON-gun renderers (`ItemRenderSPAS12`, `ItemRenderCongoLake`, `ItemRenderAm180`, `ItemRenderFlamer`, `ItemRenderSTG77`, `ItemRenderLAG`) also apply `applyRelevantTransformation("Bus")` per part; the gun's `LAMBDA_*_ANIMS` returns a Java-built `BusAnimation` or, for the 6 JSON guns, `ResourceManager.<gun>_anim.get("Fire")`.
- Particles: server builds NBT `{type, ...}` and calls `IParticleCreator.sendPacket(world, x, y, z, range, nbt)`; client `effectNT` reads `posX/Y/Z` before dispatch, checks `ParticleCreators.particleCreators`, else the legacy `"name".equals(type)` chain; sheet icons registered in `ModEventHandlerClient.onTextureStitch`.
- Sound: an `NTMSounds` string (or literal `hbm:<key>`) must match a `sounds.json` key whose `sounds[].name` resolves to `assets/hbm/sounds/<name>.ogg`. Mistakes do not crash but log WARN: `Unable to play unknown soundEvent` at play time, or `File ... does not exist, cannot add it to event ...` at resource load (currently logged for `weapon.grenadeBounce`, `fm.clap`, `fm.mug`, `fm.sample`). `NTMSounds` also holds 12 `VANILLA_*` ids (L153-164) that name vanilla events, not `sounds.json` keys. Loop pattern in area 5.
- Client event handlers registered on BOTH buses by `ClientProxy.registerClientEventHandler`.
- `@SideOnly(Side.CLIENT)` on 56/65 particle classes but only 10/648 render classes (render/ relies on being reachable only from `ClientProxy`).

### How-to

- TESR machine: triangulated OBJ with normals + named groups under `models/machines/`, texture under `textures/models/machines/`; `ResourceManager` statics; block extends `BlockDummyable`; TE keeps prev/current render fields and overrides `getRenderBoundingBox()` with a cached AABB covering the whole multiblock (without the override Forge culls the TESR against the core block's collision box, roughly 1x1x1 for a `BlockDummyable` core) plus `@SideOnly(Side.CLIENT) getMaxRenderDistanceSquared()` (exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachinePumpBase.java:195-219`; see also area 5, "Render culling"); `RenderX` copying `RenderPump` (incl. `getItemForRenderer` = `Item.getItemFromBlock(ModBlocks.x)` and an anonymous `ItemRenderBase` in `getRenderer`); bind in `ClientProxy.registerTileEntitySpecialRenderer` under the matching comment group; do NOT add a `MinecraftForgeClient.registerItemRenderer` call. Verify with F3+T. Exemplar `render/tileentity/RenderPump.java`.
- ISBRH block: a non-VBO model in `//ISBRHs`, e.g. `public static final HFRWavefrontObject x = new HFRWavefrontObject(...).noSmooth();`. It must be an `HFRWavefrontObject` instance, not the `.asVBO()` result, because `ObjUtil` takes `HFRWavefrontObject`; declare it that way or cast like `RenderBlockRotated`. The block `implements ISBRHUniversal` (`getRenderType() { return renderID; }`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false); both render methods receive `Object renderBlocks` (cast to `RenderBlocks`), which keeps the common block class loadable on the server. In `renderWorldBlock` draw into the Tessellator the chunk renderer has already started: `Tessellator.instance`, `setBrightness`, `addTranslation(x + .5, y + .5, z + .5)` ... undo it. Draw with `ObjUtil.renderWithIcon` (triangulated OBJ only: quads corrupt the stream), `ObjUtil.renderPartWithIcon` (quads and `mixedMode` OK, case-sensitive part name) or boxes via `RenderBlocksNT`. `renderInventoryBlock` must `startDrawingQuads()`/`draw()` itself (`RenderBlockRotated` L41-43; `RenderBlocksNT.renderStandardInventoryBlock` does it per face). Exemplars: OBJ drawing `render/block/RenderBlockRotated.java` (legacy handler); `ISBRHUniversal` wiring `blocks/generic/BlockRebar.java` (box-based; none of the 5 current `ISBRHUniversal` blocks uses an OBJ).
- Loop sound: `sounds/block/x.ogg` + `sounds.json` entry + `NTMSounds` constant; TE pattern from area 5; note the proxy drops pitch.
- Server-triggered particle: `@SideOnly(Side.CLIENT) ParticleX extends EntityFX`. `XCreator implements IParticleCreator` with no side annotation on the class (the server loads it to call `composeEffect`), a static `composeEffect(world, x, y, z, ...)` that fills the NBT (`type` = key) and calls `IParticleCreator.sendPacket(world, x, y, z, range, data)`, and an `@Override @SideOnly(Side.CLIENT) makeParticle(...)` (the interface's annotation is not inherited, and FML strips only annotated members). Register with `particleCreators.put("<key>", new XCreator())` in `ParticleCreators`; the key must not collide with the 67 legacy names, because `ParticleCreators` is checked first and would shadow them. Do not add branches to `effectNT`. Exemplar `particle/helper/ExplosionSmallCreator.java`.
- Gun bus animation, two routes. (a) Code-defined (most guns; 218 `new BusAnimation()` in 22 `items/weapon/sedna/factory` files): the factory's `LAMBDA_X_ANIMS` `BiFunction<ItemStack, GunAnimation, BusAnimation>` returns `new BusAnimation().addBus("RECOIL", new BusAnimationSequence().addPos(...).addRot(...).hold(...))` per `GunAnimation` and is set with `.anim(LAMBDA_X_ANIMS)`; the renderer reads `HbmAnimations.getRelevantTransformation("RECOIL")` (exemplar `render/item/weapon/sedna/ItemRenderGreasegun.java`). (b) Blender JSON (6 guns, ResourceManager L1070-1075): actions `<Anim>.<Part>`, frame 0 rest pose, YZX Euler, export with `tools/export-json-animation-4_0.py` (or 3_2/2_79) to `models/weapons/animations/<gun>.json`; `ResourceManager` `<gun>_anim = AnimationLoader.load(...)`; the lambda returns `<gun>_anim.get("Name")` (routes can be mixed per animation, e.g. the SPAS-12 EQUIP is code-built, XFactory12ga L610-623). The map is shared, so never mutate a returned `BusAnimation` (see Gotchas). The renderer applies the root bus unwrapped and wraps child parts (exemplar `render/item/weapon/sedna/ItemRenderSPAS12.java`). Either way, register the renderer in `GunFactoryClient`.
- Entity renderer: `render/entity/<group>/RenderX extends Render` (`doRender` with yaw interpolation, `bindTexture`, `renderAll`); `ResourceManager` entries; `RenderingRegistry.registerEntityRenderingHandler` in `ClientProxy`. Exemplar `render/entity/rocket/RenderMissileGeneric.java`.
- 3D item model without a TESR: `MinecraftForgeClient.registerItemRenderer(ModItems.x, new ItemRenderBase() { ... })` in `ClientProxy.registerItemRenderer` (L519-660); put per-view transforms in `renderInventory()`/`renderNonInv()` and the texture bind and OBJ draw in `renderCommon()`/`renderCommonWithStack(stack)`. Alternatively the Item implements `IItemRendererProvider` (armor pattern, e.g. `items/armor/ArmorAJR.java`) and the `Item.itemRegistry` scan picks it up; gun items register in `GunFactoryClient.init()`. `ItemRenderTransformer(rtp, ttp, stp, rfp, tfp, sfp, rir, tir, sir)` is not an OBJ renderer: it redraws the item's flat 2D icon with rotation/translation/scale per view (third person, first person, inventory), used for swords at L562-571 and tools at L577-584; `tfp` is ignored and ENTITY is left to vanilla. Legacy bulk registrations live in the @Deprecated `ItemRenderLibrary`. Items of TESR machines need nothing (`IItemRendererProvider` auto-registration).
- Keybind: area 1 how-to (`HbmKeybinds` field + `EnumKeybind` constant; existing constants: JETPACK, TOGGLE_JETPACK, TOGGLE_MAGNET, TOGGLE_HEAD, DASH, SLAM, TRAIN, CRANE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/LOAD, ABILITY_CYCLE, ABILITY_ALT, TOOL_ALT, TOOL_CTRL, GUN_PRIMARY/SECONDARY/TERTIARY, RELOAD).
- Shader: `<name>.frag` in `assets/hbm/shaders/`; `private static final Shader s = new Shader(new ResourceLocation(RefStrings.MODID, "shaders/<name>.frag"));` in a client-only class; `s.use(); s.setUniform1f(...); draw; s.stop();`. Exemplar `dim/SkyProviderCelestial.java`.

### Gotchas

- Initialising `ResourceManager` crashes the dedicated server, because its static init calls `Minecraft.getMinecraft()` (HFRWavefrontObject L85) and uploads VBOs (HFRWavefrontObjectVBO L63-76). A reference inside a method body that only runs client-side is tolerated and already common (XFactory anim lambdas, `DoorDecl` renderer/skin getters), but no static field, static initialiser, constructor or server-executed method of a common class may touch it. On the client its static init needs the GL context and runs during ModItems init (`GunFactoryClient`) at the latest.
- `HFRWavefrontObject` rejects groups mixing tris and quads unless `mixedMode = true` (then `renderAll`/`renderPart` throw; only `ObjUtil`/`tessellate*` work).
- `RenderISBRHUniversal` casts the block unconditionally: a block returning `ISBRHUniversal.renderID` without implementing the interface throws ClassCastException in chunk rendering.
- Item renderer auto-registration only covers `IItemRendererProvider`s present at `registerRenderInfo` time; missile parts are handled by `registerMissileItems`.
- Hotbar animations are keyed by unlocalized name and slot (moving the item cancels them); expiry only runs while the HUD is drawn, many times per frame. Expiry compares against `getDuration()`, and `BusAnimation.setTimeMult` (L71-75) rescales keyframes without updating `totalTime`, so a sped-up animation stays alive for its unscaled length. `Clock` advances only in `onRenderWorldLastEvent` (ModEventHandlerClient L1332), so `Clock.get_ms()` consumers stand still while the world is not rendered.
- `HbmAnimationPacket` L120 calls `setTimeMult(0.5)` on whatever the anim lambda returns when a Trenchmaster player reloads. For the 6 JSON guns that is the shared `ResourceManager` map entry; `multiplyTime` rescales from `originalDuration` and nothing sets it back to 1, so that gun's reload stays at double speed for the rest of the client session, also without the armor. Code-built animations are new per call and unaffected.
- `AudioDynamic` auto-stops only when created with a keep-alive budget (the 8-arg `getLoopedSound(..., keepAlive)` and the entity overload). It then stops after more than `keepAlive` client ticks without a `keepAlive()` call (intended failsafe). The @Deprecated 7-arg overload never sets a budget, so its loops never expire on their own. `ServerProxy.getLoopedSound` returns null for all overloads.
- `TextureAtlasSpriteMutatable` with a missing base texture crashes stitching; `ObjUtil.setColor` is global mutable tint state, applied only by `renderPartWithIcon`, not `renderWithIcon`.
- `CTStitchReceiver.receivers` (CTStitchReceiver L10) gains an entry on every `IBlockCT.primeReceiver` call from `registerBlockIcons` and is never cleared, so each resource reload adds another set and `postTextureStitch` (ModEventHandlerClient L1500) also re-processes the stale ones. The list is a plain `ArrayList`: with hodgepodge `asyncIconLoading` on, `registerBlockIcons` runs on an icon-loader pool, a racy `add` can leave a null slot, and `postTextureStitch` then NPEs while the block atlas is stitched at startup (3 crashes in the owner's history; the option is off in the current config). Fix the race together with B-405 (same list and handler).
- Owner's pack (Angelica 2.2.20, `enableThreadedChunkBuilding=true`, Iris on): no HBM ISBRH is marked `@ThreadSafeISBRH` (the fork never references it), so HBM block renderers stay on Angelica's main-thread path, as in vanilla. Angelica excludes `RenderAssemblyMachine` from model-part batching because it draws its own geometry alongside model parts (one log line per session; performance only).
- Owner's pack: 229 of the 591 HBM OGGs are stereo, and hodgepodge (`downmixStereoSounds=true`) downmixes non-streaming stereo sounds to mono, so those sounds become positional there.

- Missing-asset references outside `ResourceManager`. ## 16. Networking, packets, utilities, wiaj

### Purpose

`main/NetworkHandler` is a SimpleNetworkWrapper clone with a byte-discriminator codec (`PrecompilingNetworkCodec`) that can ship precompiled buffers from `PacketThreading`; `packet/PacketDispatcher.registerPackets()` assigns discriminators by registration order. Packet families: TE/entity sync (`BufPacket`/`EntityBufPacket` via `IBufPacketReceiver`), client->server control (`NBTControlPacket`/`NBTItemControlPacket`), particles (`AuxParticlePacketNT`), HUD messages (`PlayerInformPacket`), per-tick global state (`PermaSyncPacket`/`PermaSyncHandler`), legacy one-offs. `com/hbm/util` is the toolbox; `com/hbm/wiaj` ("World In A Jar") is the client-only scripted tutorial viewer opened with Shift+F1 over a registered item.
